lines.speaker: char_AEGIOMON
lines.text:
Make sure you look after me, okay? Otherwise, I just might 
have to play my pipes here...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Wanna try controlling me with them?

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOMON
lines.text: I dunno... For some reason, I get the feeling it wouldn't work...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What do they sound like?

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOMON
lines.text: Actually... I don't know. Everyone hears them differently.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll watch over you.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOMON
lines.text: ...Yeah, you're right. I know you'll take good care of me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're all I care about.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOMON
lines.text:
Even without playing my pipes...? Wow, thanks! I'll take 
good care of you, too.

lines.speaker: char_BLIMPMON
lines.text: Where do ya wanna go? If I can go there, I'll take ya!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Somewhere no one's ever been to before.

lines.speaker: char_BLIMPMON
lines.text: You wanna go on an adventure? A brave request... but, okay!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Somewhere I don't know about yet.

lines.speaker: char_BLIMPMON
lines.text:
The world's a big place, huh? Bet we can learn lots by 
going to different places!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Anywhere, if it's with you.

lines.speaker: char_BLIMPMON
lines.text:
Hehe. It's kinda embarrassing when ya say it out loud... 
but I feel the same way!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A place where you can rest.

lines.speaker: char_BLIMPMON
lines.text: Hehe. Thanks. Just you saying that gives me strength!

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON
lines.text:
Now that I can shoot lightning, you might get shocked 
if you touch me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not afraid of a little shock.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON
lines.text:
You really are a brave one, huh? I could learn a few things 
from you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll wear rubber gloves.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON
lines.text:
And that would protect you from lightning? Huh. You learn 
something new every day.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You'd never do anything mean like that.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON
lines.text:
Haha. There's no fooling you, huh? Yeah, don't worry. 
I'd never shock you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You already electrify me.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON
lines.text: Wow, listen to you! What a character you are! Hehe!

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_BLUE
lines.text: My left hand is so big now... Are you scared of me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_BLUE
lines.text:
Aw, I was hoping you'd be at least a little spooked... But thanks. 
I'm glad I asked.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No, but it is pretty interesting.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_BLUE
lines.text:
Oh... I guess I do have more to learn, too... about myself, 
and how to protect everyone.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: More like reassured that I can count on you.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_BLUE
lines.text:
Really? Hehe. Well, I'm counting on you, too. Let's use this 
hand of mine to save everyone!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It looks cool.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_BLUE
lines.text:
What?! R-Really? Now I'm feeling kinda self-conscious.
Hehe...

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_GREEN
lines.text:
The other day, I saw a flower garden full of roses. 
It was really beautiful.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's make weapons out of all the thorns.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_GREEN
lines.text:
Haha. Like the ones I have? True. These thorns do pack a 
prickly sting!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's gather the petals for a bath.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_GREEN
lines.text:
You mean put the petals in the water? Huh. I never thought 
of using them that way.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's go see it together.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_GREEN
lines.text: Sure, I'd love to! And I'm gonna hold you to that promise!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd like to give all the roses to you.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_GREEN
lines.text:
Um, would that really suit me...? Still, that's very nice 
of you to say. Thanks.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_DARK
lines.text: I think I wanna do something mean to you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Be mean to me and I'll be mean back.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_DARK
lines.text: Figured you'd say that. You're ready for anything, aren't you?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_DARK
lines.text:
I'm not telling. Besides, I can't just come up with these things 
outta nowhere, you know.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Please don't.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_DARK
lines.text:
Doing it even if you say not to is the whole point. But I guess 
I can skip it for today...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That isn't like you.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_DARK
lines.text:
Trying to talk me out of it? Sorry, but once you catch my eye, 
it's gonna happen.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_HOLLY
lines.text: Is your heart pure?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nope. Sorry.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_HOLLY
lines.text:
You might be joking, but I suggest you mend your ways. 
I cannot abide an impure heart.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It might be a little impure.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_HOLLY
lines.text:
Very honest of you. But think carefully. If you feel that way, 
purity is not far off.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Probably.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_HOLLY
lines.text:
So you have some doubt within you? I shall help you rid 
yourself of this uncertainty.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Of course it is.

lines.speaker: char_AEGIOCHUSMON_HOLLY
lines.text: A bold claim. But do not worry. I believe you.

lines.speaker: char_SIRENMON
lines.text: Which do you prefer, birds or fish?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Both are kind of meh...

lines.speaker: char_SIRENMON
lines.text:
Are you perhaps not a fan of me? Once you hear my song, 
I bet you'll change your tune.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Fish!

lines.speaker: char_SIRENMON
lines.text:
A fan of the sea? You'll be happy to know it feels incredible 
to sing in the ocean depths.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I like both.

lines.speaker: char_SIRENMON
lines.text:
Then I imagine you'll like my peculiar look. I feel like singing 
a song, just for you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Birds!

lines.speaker: char_SIRENMON
lines.text:
In that case, allow me to serenade you from the skies with 
my avian trill.

lines.speaker: char_LOCOMON
lines.text: How about it? Coming aboard?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet I'd get motion sickness.

lines.speaker: char_LOCOMON
lines.text:
I'd strive to keep turbulence to a minimum, so please 
overcome your trepidation.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't do well with smoke.

lines.speaker: char_LOCOMON
lines.text:
I'm really careful with humans on board. I wouldn't blow 
too much smoke, you know.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can you take me somewhere nearby?

lines.speaker: char_LOCOMON
lines.text: Near or far, I promise you a smooth and pleasant journey.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's travel to the ends of the earth!

lines.speaker: char_LOCOMON
lines.text:
Very well. It'll be a long journey for sure, so I won't slack off 
on the maintenance.

lines.speaker: char_JUPITERMON
lines.text: I must inflict divine punishment upon those who commit evil deeds.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sounds a little harsh to me...

lines.speaker: char_JUPITERMON
lines.text:
I imagine those receiving the punishment feel the same. 
That is why I judge carefully.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I say condemn the offense, not the offender.

lines.speaker: char_JUPITERMON
lines.text: But of course. I always judge good and evil without sentiment.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I support divine punishment!

lines.speaker: char_JUPITERMON
lines.text: As well you should. I do hope you never end up being judged.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wish you didn't have to.

lines.speaker: char_JUPITERMON
lines.text:
Perhaps I feel similar. Nothing would please me more than 
if my duty was no longer needed.
Have my emotions bubbled to the surface?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Too much, if you ask me.

Clearly, your judgment is off. I calmly judge the need for severe 
punishment, nothing more.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yeah, I'd say so.

I understand if you think so. Still, calmly talking like this is 
proof of my composure.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not at all.
It seems you understand the dispassion of my rage.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're pretty calm, actually.
Precisely! It seems you understand the composure behind my wrath.

lines.speaker: char_MARSMON
lines.text: I'm willing to go to any lengths to achieve victory.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Winning is important.

lines.speaker: char_MARSMON
lines.text:
My victories defend the peace of the Digital World. I could 
really use your help, too!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sometimes you have to lose to win.

lines.speaker: char_MARSMON
lines.text:
I'm defending the Digital World here, so your logic doesn't jive. 
Victory is everything.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Isn't that against the rules?

lines.speaker: char_MARSMON
lines.text:
Please understand that if it means saving the Digital World,
I'm prepared to break any rule.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Win or lose, it's best to try to get along.

lines.speaker: char_MARSMON
lines.text:
Maybe when it comes to you, but some in this world can only 
be stopped with force.

lines.speaker: char_MERCURYMON
lines.text: I am not suited for a throne.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Then hand it over!

lines.speaker: char_MERCURYMON
lines.text: That is hardly something for a human to jest about. Foolhardy, indeed.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's not true.

lines.speaker: char_MERCURYMON
lines.text:
It may appear that way to you, but the vagabond life suits me. 
It has much to offer.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You were made for it.

lines.speaker: char_MERCURYMON
lines.text:
Even if that were true, I am your ally now. I have no time to 
attend to a throne.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Hand it to someone else, then?

lines.speaker: char_MERCURYMON
lines.text:
Sure, if I meet someone worthy of it. Perhaps they will cross 
our path on this journey.

lines.speaker: char_NEPTUNEMON
lines.text: We must protect the beautiful seas.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I feel the same way.

lines.speaker: char_NEPTUNEMON
lines.text:
Feelings are certainly important, but we need action. Not that 
I have to tell you that.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How do we do that?

lines.speaker: char_NEPTUNEMON
lines.text: There is much for us to do. Shall we mull over the matter together?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd like to help.

lines.speaker: char_NEPTUNEMON
lines.text:
That is reassuring. Surely a bright future awaits us, with the 
help of humanity.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You should leave it to me.

lines.speaker: char_NEPTUNEMON
lines.text:
I appreciate the sentiment, but this is my duty. But yes, let us 
work together.

lines.speaker: char_MINERVAMON
lines.text: Spending time with a human isn't too shabby.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You may think so for now.

lines.speaker: char_MINERVAMON
lines.text:
My, is that right? Well, if you have another side to show me, 
hurry up and do it already.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It doesn't tire you out?

lines.speaker: char_MINERVAMON
lines.text:
Not at all! I enjoy learning about your daily routine. Here's to 
learning even more!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Aren't you just saying that to be polite?

lines.speaker: char_MINERVAMON
lines.text:
You're the one being standoffish and overly polite. Let's just 
be real with each other.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's stay together forever.

lines.speaker: char_MINERVAMON
lines.text:
I intend to do just that, of course. I can't imagine myself away 
from you at this point.

lines.speaker: char_MERVAMON
lines.text: You have some growing up to do.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna grow up.

lines.speaker: char_MERVAMON
lines.text:
Just thinking it won't achieve anything. Keep a level head and 
take it one step at a time.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I can't grow up.

lines.speaker: char_MERVAMON
lines.text:
Can't you? I don't mean physical maturity, but mental. It's 
all a matter of attitude.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't treat me like a kid.

lines.speaker: char_MERVAMON
lines.text:
Can you say with confidence that you're more grown-up than 
me? Something tells me no.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm already there!

lines.speaker: char_MERVAMON
lines.text:
Saying that just proves you're still a kid. Still, I like your 
innocent, childish side.

lines.speaker: char_APOLLOMON
lines.text: Am I hot?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: char_APOLLOMON
lines.text:
Perhaps I lack zeal? It seems I must redouble my training
regimen.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You are.

lines.speaker: char_APOLLOMON
lines.text:
It must be the hot blood boiling in my veins, though I do try 
to rein it in.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Too hot.

lines.speaker: char_APOLLOMON
lines.text:
In light of my role as a deity, I suppose I should take that as a 
compliment. My thanks.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sweltering.

lines.speaker: char_APOLLOMON
lines.text:
I apologize if the heat is uncomfortable, but I must not let my 
fervor as a deity waver.

lines.speaker: char_DIANAMON
lines.text: Am I... cold?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: char_DIANAMON
lines.text:
Well, be forewarned, because there are times when I can be
perceived as such.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You are.

lines.speaker: char_DIANAMON
lines.text:
Surely not all the time, though? It must seem that way because
I shoot arrows of ice...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Too cold.

lines.speaker: char_DIANAMON
lines.text:
Is that what you think?! I embrace others with a warm heart at
times, you know!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You seem cold and lifeless.

lines.speaker: char_DIANAMON
lines.text:
Is that how I look? That can't be helped, but please take note
of my other side as well.

lines.speaker: char_VULCANUSMON
lines.text: Grr...! I'm so busy I don't have enough hands to deal with it all!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Well, now you're just being greedy.

lines.speaker: char_VULCANUSMON
lines.text:
I never have enough to do my best work, but I am certainly
blessed. Better put 'em to work.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Those should be more than enough.

lines.speaker: char_VULCANUSMON
lines.text:
True. Eight might work with the right design. Better put my 
nose to the grindstone.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Shall I lend you a hand?

lines.speaker: char_VULCANUSMON
lines.text:
Friendship's all I really need. With eight limbs, I'll pay it back 
four times over!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How many more do you even need?

lines.speaker: char_VULCANUSMON
lines.text:
The more the merrier, if you ask me! Still, you're good with the 
two you've got, right?

lines.speaker: char_VENUSMON
lines.text: I will never miss a single move you make.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Thanks. Keep a close eye on me!

lines.speaker: char_VENUSMON
lines.text:
Certainly. But bear in mind that I see all—what lies on the surface, 
and within.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't look at me.

lines.speaker: char_VENUSMON
lines.text:
Whether I intend to look at you or not, I observe everything there
is to see about you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Do you have to stare so intently?

lines.speaker: char_VENUSMON
lines.text:
I promise I am not staring. However, know that I am always
watching over you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can you really see me?

lines.speaker: char_VENUSMON
lines.text:
Perceiving you with my mind, as opposed to my eyes, allows
me to see the true you.

lines.speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
lines.text: Tell me what kind of fruit you like!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Fruit with a rich aroma.

lines.speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
lines.text:
Wine from such fruit makes me drunk on the scent alone... 
I get quite generous as well!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sweet fruit.

lines.speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
lines.text:
Such fruit makes mellow brews when fermented. 
I'd love to try a few out!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sour fruit.

lines.speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
lines.text:
I love the crisp acidity of wines from such fruit. Let's have a 
drinking contest!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Juicy fruit.

lines.speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
lines.text:
Wines from juicy fruit are tangy and go down easy, especially 
with a good story!

lines.speaker: char_JUNOMON
lines.text: Am I... the jealous type?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not at all. You're compassionate and kind.

lines.speaker: char_JUNOMON
lines.text:
I am honored you think so highly of me. I shall have to keep 
my jealousy in check...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Of course not.

lines.speaker: char_JUNOMON
lines.text:
It is a relief to hear that. Still, I wonder what your basis 
for saying that is...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: char_JUNOMON
lines.text:
That response only worries me more. Still, I appreciate 
your kindness.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're a green-eyed monster.

lines.speaker: char_JUNOMON
lines.text: I see... I shall be careful not to get too attached to you.
What is wrong with being jealous?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nothing, that's what.

Then I shall surrender to this yearning. Please keep your 
eyes fixed upon me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's a waste of your beauty.

But consider this. If you cannot meet the person you love, what
is the point of beauty?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It causes trouble for everyone.
At the very least, I shall be careful not to cause you any trouble.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It makes everyone pull away from you.

I fear that is unavoidable. Keep your eyes on me, exposed 
for all to see.

lines.speaker: char_CERESMON
lines.text: Is there nowhere I can enjoy a captivating singing voice?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's not gonna be easy.

lines.speaker: char_CERESMON
lines.text:
I suppose not... But I shall not give up, so please help me
search.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not search from the sky?

lines.speaker: char_CERESMON
lines.text:
I intend to do so, naturally. Let us listen together from the
heavens!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Want me to sing for you?

lines.speaker: char_CERESMON
lines.text:
I appreciate the thought, but I seek a truly captivating voice, 
not merely human singing.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's search together.

lines.speaker: char_CERESMON
lines.text: I thank you. We shall soar the wide heavens together.
Are you not hungry?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna gather some nuts.

Take the blessings of Gaia with gratitude. Collect too many
and disaster may strike.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm full.

Yes, you seemed as though you might be. So this is how a 
contented human looks.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you offering me something?

I have the fruits of Karpos Hulē here, but they may not suit 
the human palate.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm starving.

Poor thing. Were you a Digimon, I could help, but I am afraid 
I can do nothing. Forgive me.

lines.speaker: char_PLUTOMON
lines.text: Are you afraid of me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're amazing.

lines.speaker: char_PLUTOMON
lines.text:
Too much flattery will be your ruin. Horror and violence ought 
to be feared properly.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yeah, you're scary.

lines.speaker: char_PLUTOMON
lines.text:
If you lack sin or evil worthy of the underworld, you have 
nothing to fear from me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not afraid.

lines.speaker: char_PLUTOMON
lines.text:
Of the underworld? I would not send a human like you to that 
realm in the first place.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not scared, but you're a fearsome sight.

lines.speaker: char_PLUTOMON
lines.text:
Though both human and Digimon would agree, an ally is an ally. 
You shall not be my prey.
Are there any fresh, juicy DigiCores around here?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's go look together.

I hardly expected that response... It seems you are prepared to
gaze into the abyss with me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I have no idea.

Your friends appear to have some nice DigiCores...
But I suppose you, a human, were not the one to ask.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Even if there were, I wouldn't tell you.

Teasing me, are you? Your friends will end up forfeit at this rate.
But for now, training.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Please exercise some self-restraint.

I suppose I must forbear, now that we are allies.
Take me on a trip so that I might at least forget such things.

lines.speaker: char_GRACENOVAMON
lines.text: Have you any interest in traveling the galaxy?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to.

lines.speaker: char_GRACENOVAMON
lines.text:
Set your thoughts racing to new worlds, and once day your
dreams will become reality.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What kind of place is it?

lines.speaker: char_GRACENOVAMON
lines.text:
The superspace within me is difficult to describe, but it will show 
you new worlds.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can I breathe there?

lines.speaker: char_GRACENOVAMON
lines.text:
The galaxy of the Digital World may differ from that of your own,
but I shall aid you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No, I'm good.

lines.speaker: char_GRACENOVAMON
lines.text:
So you say, but I, myself, am a galaxy. Thus, you have already
set forth on the journey.

lines.speaker: char_GROUNDLOCOMON
lines.text: Think you can keep up with my super speed?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Easily.

lines.speaker: char_GROUNDLOCOMON
lines.text:
Glad to hear it, because racing around the Net all alone
gets boring. Now, let's go!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Where are you in such a hurry to go?

lines.speaker: char_GROUNDLOCOMON
lines.text:
I want to go from one end of the Net to the other and show you
the entire Digital World!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not interested in trying.

lines.speaker: char_GROUNDLOCOMON
lines.text:
Then clear the way. I don't want to crash into you and smash
you to smithereens.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're too fast.

lines.speaker: char_GROUNDLOCOMON
lines.text:
Speed is everything to a machine. I'm only going to get faster,
so you better keep up!

lines.speaker: char_OMEGAMON
lines.text: Combat is a cruel, painful thing.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's fight together.

lines.speaker: char_OMEGAMON
lines.text:
Seems your resolve is steeled. Now that we are comrades, 
our hearts and minds are one.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: We should avoid it.

lines.speaker: char_OMEGAMON
lines.text:
The battle to purge evil is unavoidable, but I would be happy 
to hear any plan you have.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Trust me. I know.

lines.speaker: char_OMEGAMON
lines.text:
You, too, have seen your fair share of carnage. I would like to 
hear your stories someday.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It isn't cruel or painful.

lines.speaker: char_OMEGAMON
lines.text:
I suggest you drop the bluster. Instead, allow me to support 
the needs of your heart.

lines.speaker: char_GOBURIMON
lines.text: I'm crazy tough, huh? So are all my pals!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're good at running and hiding.

lines.speaker: char_GOBURIMON
lines.text:
...Wh-What?! Maybe you haven't heard, but it takes guts to know 
when to run for it!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're sneaky.

lines.speaker: char_GOBURIMON
lines.text:
Say whatever ya want! Me and my pals are just fightin' smart, 
that's all!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yeah, maybe.

lines.speaker: char_GOBURIMON
lines.text:
Then just be glad we're on the same side. I always look out for 
my friends.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: More like pretty weak.

lines.speaker: char_GOBURIMON
lines.text:
If that's what ya think, then keep me safe. I mean, we're pals, 
right? Right?

lines.speaker: char_ORGEMON
lines.text: What? I look pissed? I'm in a great mood, I tell ya!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: All I can see is an angry mug.

lines.speaker: char_ORGEMON
lines.text:
I'm in the best mood when I'm pissed! Rile me up more and 
I'll send somebody flyin'!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: In that case, let's sing.

lines.speaker: char_ORGEMON
lines.text:
Dummy! This ain't no time for a ditty! I fight tough guys when 
I'm in a good mood!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I mean, yeah, obviously.

lines.speaker: char_ORGEMON
lines.text: Right? I'm so happy, it's infuriatin'! I wanna send some joker flyin'!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Then smile, why don't you?

lines.speaker: char_ORGEMON
lines.text:
I AM smilin', dangit! What do ya think this is comin' outta my 
face, a long sneeze?!

lines.speaker: char_FUGAMON
lines.text: You workin' out?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: char_FUGAMON
lines.text:
How 'bout swingin' around a bone club like me? That'll put some 
muscle on ya.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna work out with you.

lines.speaker: char_FUGAMON
lines.text:
Ya ain't on my level, kid. Humans gotta work out human-style. 
Ya get me? Think about it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: char_FUGAMON
lines.text:
Don't look that way, but I guess it ain't fair to compare anybody 
with my jacked bod.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: char_FUGAMON
lines.text:
Then how're ya gonna defend yourself? But meh. Ain't like I wouldn't 
jump in to help.

lines.speaker: char_HYOUGAMON
lines.text: Hey, pal, youse shakin' from the chill?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's freezing. Warm me up.

lines.speaker: char_HYOUGAMON
lines.text:
How about youse and me have a li'l throwdown? My Snow Punch's 
got a spicy bite to it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm cold, but I'm not shaking.

lines.speaker: char_HYOUGAMON
lines.text:
Then lemme tell ya somethin' nice. Runnin' wild like me gets
yer blood pumpin'!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't mind it being a little nippy.

lines.speaker: char_HYOUGAMON
lines.text:
Nice, nice. How about youse put ice on yer shoulders like me? 
It makes good weapons.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Of course! This cold is bone-chilling.

lines.speaker: char_HYOUGAMON
lines.text:
What a lazybones. Why not take a jog, warm up yer body? I'll
even join ya fer a few laps.

lines.speaker: char_GREYMON
lines.text:
You're always real good to me. Hehe. Guess that means you're
a fan of mine!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Acting too full of yourself will make me mad.

lines.speaker: char_GREYMON
lines.text:
Ooh, sooo scary! But this isn't what you're really like when you're 
mad, is it?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: But what if I have some ulterior motive?

lines.speaker: char_GREYMON
lines.text:
Huh? I didn't think about that... Hmm. Why exactly are you so
good to me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Y-You've got the wrong idea.

lines.speaker: char_GREYMON
lines.text:
Hehe. Well, I'll leave it at that... But no reason not to do my best
for my partner!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yeah, you're awesome!

lines.speaker: char_GREYMON
lines.text:
Uh, yeah... Thanks. It's kinda embarrassing when you just come
out and say it like that.

lines.speaker: char_TITAMON
lines.text: The bones of the defeated are mine to claim.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How cruel.

lines.speaker: char_TITAMON
lines.text:
Just erasing the fallen may be more merciful, but it is my duty 
to collect their grudges.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sounds like a nice memorial service.

lines.speaker: char_TITAMON
lines.text:
Oh? I take possession of the fallen's grudges forever. 
Surely there is no greater disgrace.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What do you do that for?

lines.speaker: char_TITAMON
lines.text:
Data remains in their bones. By collecting them, I—we, 
really—inherit their grudges.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That sounds like quite a chore.

lines.speaker: char_TITAMON
lines.text:
I do not need your pity, human. If you must, pity the grudges 
left behind in these bones.

lines.speaker: char_CHRONOMON_BOSS_EVENT
lines.text: I wish to be free... Free from all forms of control.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You'll be free one day.

lines.speaker: char_CHRONOMON_BOSS_EVENT
lines.text:
So I must not give up hope, even though I do not know when 
that day will arrive...?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Everything comes with restrictions.

lines.speaker: char_CHRONOMON_BOSS_EVENT
lines.text: Very true. All I can do is bear this in mind...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're free now.

lines.speaker: char_CHRONOMON_BOSS_EVENT
lines.text:
Is that how you perceive it? Perhaps it is a matter of how I 
view things...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm here to help.

lines.speaker: char_CHRONOMON_BOSS_EVENT
lines.text:
I am afraid you are only trying to console me, but your support 
is appreciated.
Do you believe in fate, or perhaps destiny?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't.
Then resist until the very end. I shall do all I can to assist you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want to.

If you harbor doubts, let things come as they will.
I shall watch over you until the end.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I do.
Believing is easy. But it also brings pain. Be prepared for that.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't want to.

And what will you do about this? If you intend to resist, 
I would like to help.

lines.speaker: char_PUKAMON
lines.text: I wish I could swim for longer periods of time in the deep ocean...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Give it a shot!

lines.speaker: char_PUKAMON
lines.text: I guess I'll never learn how if I don't try, right? Okay, I'll go for it, then!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's come up with a strategy.

lines.speaker: char_PUKAMON
lines.text:
Yeah, let's look up what makes it possible. I'm ready to do it 
by the book!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Time for some special training.

lines.speaker: char_PUKAMON
lines.text:
Special training? Like, something I do on my own? I sure wish 
you'd join me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll watch you while you try.

lines.speaker: char_PUKAMON
lines.text:
I'm a little scared to try alone, so I'll be glad to have you there. 
Okay, let's do it!

lines.speaker: char_OTAMAMON
lines.text: What can I do to get better at singing?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Keep practicing, just like you've been doing!

lines.speaker: char_OTAMAMON
lines.text:
I figured I couldn't improve overnight. Thanks a bunch! I'll keep 
up the hard work!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not go to a concert?

lines.speaker: char_OTAMAMON
lines.text: That's a good idea! Hearing others sing is important, too!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll join you if you wanna practice.

lines.speaker: char_OTAMAMON
lines.text: Oh, boy! That's super nice of you! Let's sing a duet, just you and me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just sing your heart out!

lines.speaker: char_OTAMAMON
lines.text: I see what you mean! Singing's more than just skill. It's heart!

lines.speaker: char_SHAKOMON
lines.text: I wonder... What's the most charming thing about me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your powerful attacks!

lines.speaker: char_SHAKOMON
lines.text:
Yeah! I'm so cute, you'd never imagine I could throw down. 
You really get me, huh!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your tactics that throw your foes off!

lines.speaker: char_SHAKOMON
lines.text: A-yup. Battle starts from your noggin! And I'm all noggin!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That shell that protects my little friend!

lines.speaker: char_SHAKOMON
lines.text: Yeah? I thought as much! This shell of mine is pretty fine.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The fact that you're a real cutie patootie!

lines.speaker: char_SHAKOMON
lines.text: Hehehe... You're embarrassing me, here. Thanks, though.

lines.speaker: char_GOMAMON
lines.text: Fishy, fishy, fish-fish! *sigh* I wanna eat some fish...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Then go catch some, already.

lines.speaker: char_GOMAMON
lines.text: You betcha, I will! And after I catch a bunch, I'll give you some, too!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not set a trap?

lines.speaker: char_GOMAMON
lines.text:
Wouldn't it be faster if I just caught 'em? But maybe I should
give the easy way a try.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Okay, let's go fishing!

lines.speaker: char_GOMAMON
lines.text: That's what I wanted to hear! We're gonna catch a ton of fishies!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Want me to go find some?

lines.speaker: char_GOMAMON
lines.text:
Thanks. That really makes me happy! Let's find some together
and then eat 'em!

lines.speaker: char_GANIMON
lines.text: Hey, let's play that human game, rock-paper-scissors! One, two...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No mercy... Rock!

lines.speaker: char_GANIMON
lines.text: Dang it! I lost... But I won in spirit!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How about this...? The unbeatable hand!

lines.speaker: char_GANIMON
lines.text:
W-Wow! You did rock, paper and scissors all at once! I've still
got lots to learn...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll go for a draw... Scissors!

lines.speaker: char_GANIMON
lines.text: Hey, you did scissors, just like me! That means we're friends!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Guess I'll let you win... Paper!

lines.speaker: char_GANIMON
lines.text: I won! Yay! But... I know what you did... Thanks, anyway.

lines.speaker: char_KAMEMON
lines.text:
I need a makeover... What should I change to give me that 
wow factor?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Swap out your helmet for a new one!

lines.speaker: char_KAMEMON
lines.text:
I see. I ought to be brave enough to change the stuff that stands 
out the most!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not start by reading a fashion magazine?

lines.speaker: char_KAMEMON
lines.text:
A fashion mag...? Huh. Like a book that shows you the latest 
duds? Sounds interesting!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll make you some new clothes.

lines.speaker: char_KAMEMON
lines.text:
You'd do all that? For little ol' me? You have no idea how happy 
that makes me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're fabulous the way you are.

lines.speaker: char_KAMEMON
lines.text:
Aw, shucks... Thanks. I mean it. Don't mind the blushing 
and everything...

lines.speaker: char_SEADRAMON
lines.text: My tail... Me, proud. Must get stronger!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You can still get stronger!

lines.speaker: char_SEADRAMON
lines.text: Of course! But me, happy you say that...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not develop a new move?

lines.speaker: char_SEADRAMON
lines.text: A new move... Yes, cool. You, help me think...?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll help you with training.

lines.speaker: char_SEADRAMON
lines.text: Train together... That sound fun. Me, happy...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The red on the tip of your tail is cool.

lines.speaker: char_SEADRAMON
lines.text: Yes! Red part, cool! You... understand good!

lines.speaker: char_OCTMON
lines.text: Arrr! 'ave ye spied any fancy booty as o' late?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wouldn't mind a treasure hunt.

lines.speaker: char_OCTMON
lines.text:
Aye, a search fraught with peril. May we find lands the likes 
o' which ne'er been seen.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not read an old tome?

lines.speaker: char_OCTMON
lines.text:
Yo ho! Perhaps we may find knowledge within o' plunder what 
been squirreled away.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's go look for some together!

lines.speaker: char_OCTMON
lines.text:
Well, ain't ye a sight for sore eyes! One's luck only grows 
among mates—as do the mirth!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're the real treasure.

lines.speaker: char_OCTMON
lines.text:
Blow me down! I 'adn't thought o' that. Ye done pleased this 
ole sea dog beyond measure.

lines.speaker: char_GAWAPPAMON
lines.text: *sigh* Gotta get me some new tunes to get this heart thumpin'...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Maybe you should make your own.

lines.speaker: char_GAWAPPAMON
lines.text: I never thought of that! My own tracks... Now, that'd be hype!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not hit up the clubs?

lines.speaker: char_GAWAPPAMON
lines.text:
Now you're talkin'! Nothin' beats bein' there right in the middle 
of the music!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Want me to sing something?

lines.speaker: char_GAWAPPAMON
lines.text: You'd sing just for me? That'd be hella cool!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You really love music, huh?

lines.speaker: char_GAWAPPAMON
lines.text:
A life without music ain't worth livin'! Gotta keep the tunes
bumpin' every day!

lines.speaker: char_WHAMON
lines.text: Ho, boy... My tummy doesn't feel right...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not gulp down some water?

lines.speaker: char_WHAMON
lines.text:
Oh, I see! If I ate something funny, I could flush it out with a nice, 
big swallow, huh?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Should we check for a stomach bug?

lines.speaker: char_WHAMON
lines.text:
Better to check than to try and deal with it blindly, for sure.
Good call!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Should I take a look inside your stomach?

lines.speaker: char_WHAMON
lines.text:
What? You'd be willing to go in there? For me? How thoughtful
of you... Thank you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Aw, that's too bad... But I'm here for you!

lines.speaker: char_WHAMON
lines.text:
Those words ease the pain better than any medicine could.
Thank you for your kindness.

lines.speaker: char_MEGASEADRAMON
lines.text: My blade... amazing... Kehehe.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: And powerful, to boot!

lines.speaker: char_MEGASEADRAMON
lines.text: You... get it. Blade, strong! Blade, COOL!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It'd be even better if you took care of it.

lines.speaker: char_MEGASEADRAMON
lines.text: Took... care? Me, never think about that... Me, study...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Want me to polish it for you?

lines.speaker: char_MEGASEADRAMON
lines.text: Yes! Me, grateful. You, good person.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're pretty amazing yourself!

lines.speaker: char_MEGASEADRAMON
lines.text: Me, too? Not just blade...? You, say nice things.

lines.speaker: char_WARUSEADRAMON
lines.text: Make me sound cool when you talk to me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: All hail the hero WaruSeadramon!

lines.speaker: char_WARUSEADRAMON
lines.text: You keeping talking to me like that, and I bet I can really cut loose!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Good day to you, Brave WaruSeadramon!

lines.speaker: char_WARUSEADRAMON
lines.text:
Makes me sound like one of those wandering samurai types. 
Yeah, it's got a ring to it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What it is, my WaruSeadramon.

lines.speaker: char_WARUSEADRAMON
lines.text: Sounds very... friendly. Yup, I like it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Hey, Li'l WaruSeadramon!

lines.speaker: char_WARUSEADRAMON
lines.text:
"Li'l" is the total opposite of cool! It's cute, even! Still... 
Not so bad, I guess.

lines.speaker: char_DAGOMON
lines.text: Darkness... is... comforting...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's go for a stroll in the sunlight.

lines.speaker: char_DAGOMON
lines.text: I do not like it... yet it may be interesting to attempt.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Where does darkness come from, I wonder...

lines.speaker: char_DAGOMON
lines.text:
A fair question to ask. As to the answer... Seek that for
yourself.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's go for a nighttime stroll, then.

lines.speaker: char_DAGOMON
lines.text:
You choose darkness as I have? Hmm. Perhaps it would not
hurt to join you this once.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're easy to find even in the dark.

lines.speaker: char_DAGOMON
lines.text:
Finding me in the gloom is no easy task... except, perhaps,
for you...

lines.speaker: char_SHAWUJINMON
lines.text: I want to live the slow life on a river with clean waters.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why don't we go look for that river of yours?

lines.speaker: char_SHAWUJINMON
lines.text: That sounds like a great time! I might actually take you up on that.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's study how to clean up the rivers, then.

lines.speaker: char_SHAWUJINMON
lines.text:
Oh! We can make rivers clean again with our own hands? 
I really like that idea.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: We can clean up the rivers together.

lines.speaker: char_SHAWUJINMON
lines.text:
It might take some time, but a little river cleanup could be fun 
if we take it slow.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd protect a river where you could live.

lines.speaker: char_SHAWUJINMON
lines.text: I get the feeling you'd really do it, too! You've got my trust.

lines.speaker: char_METALSEADRAMON
lines.text: I want to take over the vast oceans, rampaging wherever I please.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You could do it right now, if you wanted.

lines.speaker: char_METALSEADRAMON
lines.text:
Yes. If I felt like it, I'd rule over all the seas. Shall I show you 
how I'd do it?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: There are all kinds of seas around the world.

lines.speaker: char_METALSEADRAMON
lines.text:
True. And different seas require different methods of attack. 
I should do some research.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna go with you!

lines.speaker: char_METALSEADRAMON
lines.text:
You want to see my glorious romp through the seas? Hmm. 
I'll take you along someday...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet you look beautiful when you swim.

lines.speaker: char_METALSEADRAMON
lines.text:
You understand well. Yes, my true beauty is on full display 
when I'm in the ocean waves.

lines.speaker: char_PLESIOMON
lines.text: Allow me to hear your ambitions.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Traveling anywhere and everywhere!

lines.speaker: char_PLESIOMON
lines.text:
Trek across this wide world, would you? That is a fine ambition, 
nay, a fine dream.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Knowing everything about the world.

lines.speaker: char_PLESIOMON
lines.text:
You are greedier for knowledge than I ever imagined. Such 
hunger pleases me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Helping you out with your ambition.

lines.speaker: char_PLESIOMON
lines.text:
My ambition... That is greater strength. Perhaps with you, 
I could pursue this goal.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Being with you forever and ever.

lines.speaker: char_PLESIOMON
lines.text:
Hmph. If that is your wish, very well. Not that I condemn such
an aim.

lines.speaker: char_MARINEANGEMON
lines.text: How can everyone live in peace, I wonder...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: By having the courage to talk to each other.

lines.speaker: char_MARINEANGEMON
lines.text:
Courage... I'm sure I'm lacking that. I feel like I can get some 
by sticking around you, though!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Understanding each other is key.

lines.speaker: char_MARINEANGEMON
lines.text:
You're right. It's hard to be together, much less talk, if you lack 
empathy and insight.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's think of a way together.

lines.speaker: char_MARINEANGEMON
lines.text:
Having you to depend on really puts me at ease. Let's keep on 
keeping on, together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: With love, peace is sure to follow.

lines.speaker: char_MARINEANGEMON
lines.text:
Yeah. No matter what, I'll keep love and hope in my heart... 
especially for you!

lines.speaker: char_JUMBOGAMEMON
lines.text: *crash* *boom* Me, shiny, buff body! Me, super cool!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Looking swole, pal!

lines.speaker: char_JUMBOGAMEMON
lines.text:
Hehehe... Me hoped you say that. Me wanna join human 
bodybuildin' competition!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: And with smarts to match!

lines.speaker: char_JUMBOGAMEMON
lines.text: Me, brawn AND brains! Lookit me go! *crash* *bang*

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: So jealous!

lines.speaker: char_JUMBOGAMEMON
lines.text:
You want me train you, too? We get real tough. JumboGamemon 
guarantee!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your heart's practically shining, too!

lines.speaker: char_JUMBOGAMEMON
lines.text:
Me, heart shine, but nobody else see... But you! You see. Me, 
take shine to YOU!

lines.speaker: char_BUBBMON
lines.text: Googoo, gaga!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you angry?

lines.speaker: char_BUBBMON
lines.text:
If that's what ya think, then put your dukes up! Googoo! 
I'm comin' for ya! Gaga!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you hungry?

lines.speaker: char_BUBBMON
lines.text:
If that's what ya think, then feed me! Googoo!
Figure out what I wanna eat! Gaga!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you having fun?

lines.speaker: char_BUBBMON
lines.text:
You guessed it, so now ya gotta babble with me! Googoo! 
C'mon! Let's sing! Gaga!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you in pain?

lines.speaker: char_BUBBMON
lines.text:
You guessed it, so now ya gotta say, "Pain, pain, go away!"
Googoo!

lines.speaker: char_PYOCOMON
lines.text: Isn't the flower on my head just darling?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I've never seen anything like it.

lines.speaker: char_PYOCOMON
lines.text:
I'll Digivolve into a form that's just as pretty as your world's 
flowers. You'll see!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is that a question mark?

lines.speaker: char_PYOCOMON
lines.text:
Hmm. I guess it kind of looks like one, huh? It's as odd as 
it is beautiful!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is it wilting?

lines.speaker: char_PYOCOMON
lines.text:
I know it's yellow, but that's just the way it looks. No need to
fret. Honest!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What should I call it?

lines.speaker: char_PYOCOMON
lines.text:
Why, any name you like. I can't wait to hear what lovely label 
you come up with!

lines.speaker: char_MOCHIMON
lines.text: Want me to try puffing up my body?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to see that!

lines.speaker: char_MOCHIMON
lines.text:
Don't just watch me! If you like what you see, then let's fight
together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What's so interesting about that?

lines.speaker: char_MOCHIMON
lines.text: Humans seem to get a kick out of it. Take a gander anytime!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You don't have to.

lines.speaker: char_MOCHIMON
lines.text: Come on, no need to be so uptight! I'm ready to go anytime!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Does it hurt?

lines.speaker: char_MOCHIMON
lines.text:
Far from it. It actually feels pretty good. Let's puff up together
someday!

lines.speaker: char_TANEMON
lines.text: Look! Look! My seedling is sprouting!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's looking a bit dry, actually.

lines.speaker: char_TANEMON
lines.text:
How rude. Far from being dry, it's full of vitality! You'd do well 
to learn from it!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Will it end up blooming?

lines.speaker: char_TANEMON
lines.text:
Couldn't say for sure, but I bet it will. Keep a real close eye on it 
for me, okay?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What kind of seedling is it?

lines.speaker: char_TANEMON
lines.text:
Couldn't tell you, but I'm sure it'll be key to my Digivolution! 
Keep a close eye on me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Want me to water it?

lines.speaker: char_TANEMON
lines.text:
Aw, how kind! Still, don't worry. I'm sure I'll Digivolve beautifully 
no matter what!

lines.speaker: char_PIYOMON
lines.text: I wonder what lies beyond the skies...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Old ruins, maybe?

lines.speaker: char_PIYOMON
lines.text:
Ooh! Let's go on an adventure! Just thinking about it gets 
me all atwitter!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Perhaps an unknown world.

lines.speaker: char_PIYOMON
lines.text:
I see! Yeah, could be! I want to learn about all kinds of things 
I don't know yet!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: New friends await!

lines.speaker: char_PIYOMON
lines.text:
Hee hee! I bet you're right! New friends, wait for me! I'll be 
there someday soon!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's find out together.

lines.speaker: char_PIYOMON
lines.text:
Okay! Hey, can we hold hands? When I'm with you, I feel like 
I could soar!

lines.speaker: char_TENTOMON
lines.text: The good ol' sol is nice and toasty! Sooo soothin'!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm ready to burn bright!

lines.speaker: char_TENTOMON
lines.text: Yer rarin' to go, ain't ya? Ya even got me in a tizzy over here!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The sol? What's "the sol"?

lines.speaker: char_TENTOMON
lines.text:
I'm referrin' to the sun, pal. Hehe. This dome of mine ain't just 
for show, ya know!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Makes you wanna take a nap, huh?

lines.speaker: char_TENTOMON
lines.text:
Yup, totally... *yawn* How's about you and me take a nice little 
siesta next time?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Since it's so soothing, why not take a break?

lines.speaker: char_TENTOMON
lines.text: Nah, I'm good. Though I appreciate ya lookin' out for me, pal.

lines.speaker: char_FUNBEEMON
lines.text: Hey there. Anything I can bee of help with?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Well, could you carry this stuff?

lines.speaker: char_FUNBEEMON
lines.text: Sure, leave it to me! I'm good at carrying things!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What kind of flower is that?

lines.speaker: char_FUNBEEMON
lines.text: Let's see... Hmm, I don't know! But I'll check around and find out!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Bee my friend!

lines.speaker: char_FUNBEEMON
lines.text: Huh? But I can't... beecause we're already friends, right?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You help enough just by being here.

lines.speaker: char_FUNBEEMON
lines.text: Haha! You're so silly. But thanks. I'll always BEE here for you!

lines.speaker: char_FLORAMON
lines.text: I'm a little thirsty...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Tough it out!

lines.speaker: char_FLORAMON
lines.text: Okay, time to be tough...! *panting* Now I'm even more thirsty.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sipping water slowly hydrates you better.

lines.speaker: char_FLORAMON
lines.text: Really? I wish I knew all kinds of stuff like you do.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yeah, me, too...

lines.speaker: char_FLORAMON
lines.text: Then can we take a break? I'm gonna dry up at this rate.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You can have some of my water.

lines.speaker: char_FLORAMON
lines.text: Th-Thanks... I'll savor every drop.

lines.speaker: char_MUSHMON
lines.text: What kind of prank should I pull next?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: If you're gonna prank, then prank fair!

lines.speaker: char_MUSHMON
lines.text:
The heck does that even mean? Though, hmm... Maybe you're 
onto something there.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What kind of pranks have you pulled so far?

lines.speaker: char_MUSHMON
lines.text: You wanna know? Then lemme give you the rundown.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Wanna have a strategy session about it?

lines.speaker: char_MUSHMON
lines.text: Hehehe. Oh, you're baaad! I dig it. Let's give it a nice, long think.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You can prank me, but only me.

lines.speaker: char_MUSHMON
lines.text:
How weird, wanting to get pranked. But if you insist, I'll 
go crazy with it.

lines.speaker: char_HAWKMON
lines.text: What would you do if you met someone in trouble?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd help them, of course!

lines.speaker: char_HAWKMON
lines.text: Wonderful! I feel I would do the same.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd ask what's bothering them.

lines.speaker: char_HAWKMON
lines.text:
Indeed, if we knew the cause, then perhaps we could do
something to help.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd try and cheer them up.

lines.speaker: char_HAWKMON
lines.text:
We all get troubled from time to time. It is no wonder you
would like to comfort them.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd give them a hug!

lines.speaker: char_HAWKMON
lines.text:
S-Such extreme measures...! Still, I suppose that would most
easily convey your intent...

lines.speaker: char_MUCHOMON
lines.text: I picked a bunch of fruit! What color do you wanna eat?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The red one looks like it'll perk me up!

lines.speaker: char_MUCHOMON
lines.text: Nice! The spicy red one! I bet you'll be breathing fire in no time!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wonder how the dark purple one tastes.

lines.speaker: char_MUCHOMON
lines.text:
It sure is a weird color. Never tried it, myself. I always wondered 
what it tastes like.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's eat the yellow one together.

lines.speaker: char_MUCHOMON
lines.text:
It's tasty, but that peel is no joke. Let's try and split that bad boy 
open together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll have the pink, spongy one.

lines.speaker: char_MUCHOMON
lines.text: This fruit's real, real easy to bruise. Handle it gently, okay?

lines.speaker: char_WORMMON
lines.text: Say, what do ya wanna do when ya grow up?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna try all sorts of challenges!

lines.speaker: char_WORMMON
lines.text: Yeah, hard to choose just one, huh? Best to have lots of dreams!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna learn all kinds of things!

lines.speaker: char_WORMMON
lines.text: I see! I got plenty to learn, too. I oughta follow yer example!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna make all sorts of friends!

lines.speaker: char_WORMMON
lines.text:
A buncha friends, huh? Sure would be nice. Of course, you and 
me are already friends!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna be with you, even when we're all grown up!

lines.speaker: char_WORMMON
lines.text:
...Heck yeah–and ya will! No matter what happens, we'll
always be pals!

lines.speaker: char_LALAMON
lines.text: La laaa, la la laaaaa! ♪

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That tune's so inspiring!

lines.speaker: char_LALAMON
lines.text:
Oh, yes! I committed the bravery inside of me to song. 
I'm glad it resonated with you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's an odd little ditty.

lines.speaker: char_LALAMON
lines.text:
I committed the quizzical, inquisitive nature within me 
to song. La la laaa! ♪

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Such a pleasant melody.

lines.speaker: char_LALAMON
lines.text:
It's my song of friendship! A tune to say everyone should 
have fun together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is that a lullaby?

lines.speaker: char_LALAMON
lines.text:
Hoho. Not even close. But if you want one so badly, I'd be 
happy to croon to you gently.

lines.speaker: char_AQUILAMON
lines.text: I wonder... How do you find my performance?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're strong and reliable.

lines.speaker: char_AQUILAMON
lines.text: You are too kind. I will continue to give you my best efforts!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your intelligence is a huge help.

lines.speaker: char_AQUILAMON
lines.text:
I am honored to be of service. I will continue to hone 
my mental prowess!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're a very good friend.

lines.speaker: char_AQUILAMON
lines.text:
Why, thank you! Having you think of me as an equal is a 
great honor!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're awesome!

lines.speaker: char_AQUILAMON
lines.text: ...Thank you. I value you as well.

lines.speaker: char_WOODMON
lines.text: Ain't nothing out there that can spook me! No way!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not even fire?

lines.speaker: char_WOODMON
lines.text: Ugh... N-Nope, not scared! I can... I can knock it right back!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's important to know your weak points.

lines.speaker: char_WOODMON
lines.text: Y-You think so? Maybe you're right... Guess I got a lot to learn.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Together, the two of us are untouchable!

lines.speaker: char_WOODMON
lines.text: Exactly! Nobody can get in the way of our friendship!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: So, what out there delights you?

lines.speaker: char_WOODMON
lines.text: Huh. Never even thought about it. I wonder...

lines.speaker: char_KABUTERIMON
lines.text: Tell me. What I need to live long?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The courage to live on.

lines.speaker: char_KABUTERIMON
lines.text:
Courage... No understand the heart. But my chest... warm. 
This, courage?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The knowledge to survive.

lines.speaker: char_KABUTERIMON
lines.text: Knowledge... I lack. That why I so curious, I think.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Friends who help each other.

lines.speaker: char_KABUTERIMON
lines.text: Help each other... Taught me, you did. So important... friends are.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A loving heart.

lines.speaker: char_KABUTERIMON
lines.text: Love... That hard. Teach me more. Me, still much to learn.

lines.speaker: char_KIWIMON
lines.text: The idea someone could attack me at any time freaks me out...!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Then fight back!

lines.speaker: char_KIWIMON
lines.text:
O-Okay... I guess I have gotten tougher. If they hit me, I'll hit 
them right back!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why don't you think of a way to escape?

lines.speaker: char_KIWIMON
lines.text: You're right. I'll think up all sorts of ways to flee if I get scared!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You can just befriend them.

lines.speaker: char_KIWIMON
lines.text:
Sure. I don't like fighting, anyway. I just hope everyone's friendly 
like you...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll protect you, Kiwimon!

lines.speaker: char_KIWIMON
lines.text: Okay... Thanks a bunch! I sure am lucky to have a pal like you!

lines.speaker: char_GEKOMON
lines.text:
I'll play a tune to liven things up, glurp. Got any requests,
glurp?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Something bold and stirring.

lines.speaker: char_GEKOMON
lines.text:
You got it, glurp! Just hearing this song'll get those heroic
juices flowing, glurp!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Something sophisticated.

lines.speaker: char_GEKOMON
lines.text:
That could be a tough one, glurp... But nothing's impossible
for me, glurp!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Something fun.

lines.speaker: char_GEKOMON
lines.text:
Leave it to me, glurp! I've got a good-vibes number that'll get 
everybody dancing, glurp!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Something sad.

lines.speaker: char_GEKOMON
lines.text:
Say no more, glurp! There won't be a dry eye around once this 
tearjerker starts, glurp!

lines.speaker: char_TOGEMON
lines.text: You and me, staring contest! First to smile loses!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Grr, I'm gonna mug at you good!

lines.speaker: char_TOGEMON
lines.text: Ngh! Two can play at that game. Arrrrr!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The cooler head will prevail.

lines.speaker: char_TOGEMON
lines.text: That sounds... pretty smart, actually. You mean, like this?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Get a load of this funny face!

lines.speaker: char_TOGEMON
lines.text:
Oh, boy. That's a good one. I appreciate you coming at 
this so seriously.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Aww, what a cutie you are.

lines.speaker: char_TOGEMON
lines.text:
Ack, you made me smile! It's my loss... Still, not a bad way 
to go out. No, indeed!

lines.speaker: char_VEGIMON
lines.text: Kehehe. I'm bored! Tell me a good story!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Okay, here's one about fighting monsters.

lines.speaker: char_VEGIMON
lines.text:
Whoa, that Momotaro guy's awesome! Now I'm all fired up!
Kehe!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Okay, the one about the treasure box.

lines.speaker: char_VEGIMON
lines.text:
So unfair that Urashima Taro got all old just for helping that
turtle! I wanna know why!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How about "The Monkey and the Crab"?

lines.speaker: char_VEGIMON
lines.text:
So even little crabs and their friends can beat a monkey 
if they work together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How about "The Tale of Princess Kaguya"?

lines.speaker: char_VEGIMON
lines.text:
So sad she went back to the moon and left those old folks 
behind... *sniffle*

lines.speaker: char_WASPMON
lines.text:
Halt! Who goes there?! Ah... Sorry. Just a habit from my
patrols.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You sure are reliable!

lines.speaker: char_WASPMON
lines.text:
That makes all of my vigilance worthwhile. I'll take down any 
suspicious parties!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why are you so vigilant?

lines.speaker: char_WASPMON
lines.text:
Why, you ask...? Force of habit, I guess. I should think for
myself a little more.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll leave it to you to keep watch.

lines.speaker: char_WASPMON
lines.text:
Yes, as you should. I'll have you watch my back in return,
partner.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Thanks for all your hard work.

lines.speaker: char_WASPMON
lines.text:
The acknowledgment is appreciated. After all... it's you I'm 
working hard to protect.

lines.speaker: char_SUNFLOWMON
lines.text: There's no sun at night, so it's a little boring.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: We could try spooking each other for fun.

lines.speaker: char_SUNFLOWMON
lines.text: You mean, like a test of courage? Wow... You must be pretty brave.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not turn on some lights?

lines.speaker: char_SUNFLOWMON
lines.text:
Oh, yeah. I didn't think of that! You're a smart cookie. 
I could learn a thing or two.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It'd be a blast to hang out together.

lines.speaker: char_SUNFLOWMON
lines.text: Really? You mean, like, tonight? I'm in!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just sleep. We'll pick this up tomorrow...

lines.speaker: char_SUNFLOWMON
lines.text:
Yep, that's the best idea! Let's grab some sleep, and regroup 
in the morning!

lines.speaker: char_FLYMON
lines.text: Bzz... How do you like my wings?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: They look cool and tough!

lines.speaker: char_FLYMON
lines.text:
Bzz! Right? I'll show you how I use them to fly around and take
out foes!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna study them more closely.

lines.speaker: char_FLYMON
lines.text:
More curious than you are scared, huh? All right. Get as close
a look as you want.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Scary but pretty.

lines.speaker: char_FLYMON
lines.text:
Scared, huh? Bzz. How honest of ya. But relax. I'd never hurt
a partner.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Very cute and charming.

lines.speaker: char_FLYMON
lines.text:
Cute...? Now, that really throws me off. But... I guess not
necessarily in a bad way.

lines.speaker: char_GARUDAMON
lines.text: I'm the guardian of justice and order in the world!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sorry for causing so much trouble.

lines.speaker: char_GARUDAMON
lines.text:
If you feel that way, then mend your ways. Now, and without
troubling me further.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you sure things aren't a little chaotic?

lines.speaker: char_GARUDAMON
lines.text:
That's how it appears to you, is it? Still, this bears looking into
on my end as well.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Great! Good luck with that.

lines.speaker: char_GARUDAMON
lines.text:
Of course. It's my duty, after all. However, as my companion,
you'll be assisting me, too.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's be guardians together.

lines.speaker: char_GARUDAMON
lines.text:
That sentiment is most welcome. I'm certain there is much you
can do.

lines.speaker: char_SILPHYMON
lines.text: These parts of mine remind you of anything?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: char_SILPHYMON
lines.text:
No powers of observation, huh? Focus on your friends and you'll 
see all kinds of things.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Gatomon's ears.

lines.speaker: char_SILPHYMON
lines.text:
Good catch. You can have the data I get from this radar and 
head-mounted display anytime.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Aquilamon's wings!

lines.speaker: char_SILPHYMON
lines.text:
The wings do stand out, huh? They let me glide freely, arriving 
safely by your side.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Aquilamon's legs?

lines.speaker: char_SILPHYMON
lines.text:
Splendid, yes? I can bound into the air even without wings, so
I can protect you anywhere.

lines.speaker: char_ATLURKABUTERIMON
lines.text: I have a question. What is it you wish to protect?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: My principles!

lines.speaker: char_ATLURKABUTERIMON
lines.text: Ah, so you have convictions, do you? I wish I were like you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Maybe my memories?

lines.speaker: char_ATLURKABUTERIMON
lines.text:
Without memories, everything you have been up to now would 
disappear... A scary thought.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: My dear friends.

lines.speaker: char_ATLURKABUTERIMON
lines.text: You are such a caring person. Let us protect our friends together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You, MegaKabuterimon.

lines.speaker: char_ATLURKABUTERIMON
lines.text: ...Wh-Why, thank you. I would like to keep you safe as well.

lines.speaker: char_ETEMON
lines.text:
I'm thinking of writing a new song. What kind of music should
I do?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Hot and heavy rock!

lines.speaker: char_ETEMON
lines.text: Rock! I like that! My fiery heart is gonna set ya ablaze!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sophisticated classical music!

lines.speaker: char_ETEMON
lines.text: Classical! Sounds tough, but I like a good challenge!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A rap about friendship!

lines.speaker: char_ETEMON
lines.text: Love to all my homies out there! The rap master is in the house!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Love Serenade No. 2!

lines.speaker: char_ETEMON
lines.text:
Hey, a follow-up could work! Everybody's gonna get a dose 
of heartbreak!

lines.speaker: char_TONOSAMAGEKOMON
lines.text: I sang too much, and got a frog in my throat, glurp...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Clearly you need more practice.

lines.speaker: char_TONOSAMAGEKOMON
lines.text:
This isn't enough to deter me, glurp! A little break, and I'll 
be back at it, glurp!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's just because the air is so dry.

lines.speaker: char_TONOSAMAGEKOMON
lines.text:
I wouldn't have opened up the pipes if I'd known, glurp. 
Tell a 'mon beforehand, glurp!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Well, you did sleep with your mouth open...

lines.speaker: char_TONOSAMAGEKOMON
lines.text:
How rude, glurp! At least my snoring sounds better than 
those Gekomon, glurp!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You sing too much anyway.

lines.speaker: char_TONOSAMAGEKOMON
lines.text:
But my fans are always waiting to hear me croon, glurp! 
I can't let them down, glurp!

lines.speaker: char_DELUMON
lines.text: What do you think is inside this thicket on my back?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Weapons for taking out enemies!

lines.speaker: char_DELUMON
lines.text:
Yes, that is correct! True royalty meets force with force and 
never yields!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Books for studying?

lines.speaker: char_DELUMON
lines.text:
Qu-Quite right. Royalty must be wise... and I must do a little
reading.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Snacks to share with friends!

lines.speaker: char_DELUMON
lines.text:
Precisely. It is the duty of the nobility to aid those less
fortunate!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Maybe handwritten poems?

lines.speaker: char_DELUMON
lines.text:
Indeed. Sad love sonnets penned each night as I— Wait. 
What rubbish have you got me saying?

lines.speaker: char_JYUREIMON
lines.text: I ask that you protect and treasure the deep green forest.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's dangerous deep in the forest.

lines.speaker: char_JYUREIMON
lines.text:
I would never put friends in danger, yet who knows what awaits 
those who tread carelessly?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Moderate logging is necessary, though.

lines.speaker: char_JYUREIMON
lines.text:
I am heartened by your knowledge on the subject. As long as 
it is not to excess.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll help any way I can.

lines.speaker: char_JYUREIMON
lines.text:
I do not require much. Simply leave nature to her course and 
she will provide.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I promise to cherish the forest.

lines.speaker: char_JYUREIMON
lines.text:
I would be thrilled if everyone thought that way. Watch over it, 
at a proper distance.

lines.speaker: char_LILAMON
lines.text: Every beautiful flower has its poison, you know.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A little poison doesn't scare me.

lines.speaker: char_LILAMON
lines.text:
I wouldn't be so flippant, if I were you. Careful not to let 
beauty lead you astray.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't you mean "has its thorns"?

lines.speaker: char_LILAMON
lines.text:
That may be true as well. If you're putting in that much thought, 
I guess you'll be fine.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Fine by me, as long as it's pretty.

lines.speaker: char_LILAMON
lines.text:
Forgive me if I don't agree. Here's to hoping that sentiment 
never comes back to bite you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll keep my distance, then.

lines.speaker: char_LILAMON
lines.text:
Aren't you the careful sort? That's actually a relief to hear. 
I want to keep you around.

lines.speaker: char_LILLYMON
lines.text: Say, how do I look from your perspective?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Like a strong young woman.

lines.speaker: char_LILLYMON
lines.text: That's because you keep me bright-eyed and bushy-tailed!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Like an adult.

lines.speaker: char_LILLYMON
lines.text:
Hee hee. You have no idea what a fine specimen of maturity 
I've become.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Like a sweet, gentle girl.

lines.speaker: char_LILLYMON
lines.text: My! You really do understand me, don't you?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Like a reliable big sister.

lines.speaker: char_LILLYMON
lines.text: Thanks! And I hope you'll come to rely on me more and more.

lines.speaker: char_HERCULESKABUTERIMON
lines.text: A strong heart dwells within a strong body!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A strong heart is more important.

lines.speaker: char_HERCULESKABUTERIMON
lines.text:
Without a strong heart, one falls prey to cowardice. You are
right about that.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A strong body's more important.

lines.speaker: char_HERCULESKABUTERIMON
lines.text:
True. One cannot prevail without a strong body. Utilize your
mind, certainly, but train your body first.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: And I have both!

lines.speaker: char_HERCULESKABUTERIMON
lines.text: I am envious! I should follow your example.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's best to have at least one.

lines.speaker: char_HERCULESKABUTERIMON
lines.text:
Agreed. Or you could have one, and your friend the other. It
would be most unfortunate not to have either.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON
lines.text: What's this? Were you looking it me, by any chance?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I was captivated by your beauty.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON
lines.text:
I can hardly blame you. Go on, then. Feast your eyes until 
you're satiated.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I was wondering how you got so gorgeous.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON
lines.text: It must all be thanks to my desire to remain ravishing at all times.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I couldn't help myself.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON
lines.text:
Infatuated with my eternal beauty, are you? I will stay 
by your side forever.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I was looking because I like you.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON
lines.text:
I can accept your feelings, but be ready to be ever captivated 
by me, body and soul.

lines.speaker: char_PINOCHIMON
lines.text: Just so you know, I'm a bit of a fibber.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Even I tell a lie or two sometimes.

lines.speaker: char_PINOCHIMON
lines.text:
My lies aren't so trite! Anyway, don't come crying to me if you 
end up feeling taken in.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is that a fib, too?

lines.speaker: char_PINOCHIMON
lines.text: Urgh, touché. You win this round...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You ought to quit all that.

lines.speaker: char_PINOCHIMON
lines.text: You're right. I'll never, ever lie again— Whoopsie! I done dood it again.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll forgive little white lies.

lines.speaker: char_PINOCHIMON
lines.text:
Okey-dokey. I'll lie so good you won't even know you're 
being hoodwinked.

lines.speaker: char_SHURIMON
lines.text: You may leave the shuriken work to me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Go on. Give one a throw, then.

lines.speaker: char_SHURIMON
lines.text:
I fear I must refuse. My shuriken always find their mark. 
I shall not take a life this day.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Teach me how to throw them!

lines.speaker: char_SHURIMON
lines.text:
It will not do much good if you cannot extend your limbs like I can. 
Still, observe!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Lend me one of your shuriken.

lines.speaker: char_SHURIMON
lines.text:
These shuriken are my life. Even if I trust in you, I cannot hand
them over so readily.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Okay. I'll leave it to you.

lines.speaker: char_SHURIMON
lines.text:
Very good. I vow on these shuriken I shall protect my comrades 
until my last breath!

lines.speaker: char_KUWAGAMON
lines.text: What aspect of mine makes me seem the toughest?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Those big, ol' pincers of yours.

lines.speaker: char_KUWAGAMON
lines.text:
Hehehe. I thought as much. I'm always itching to pinch 
something with them.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your keen battle strategy.

lines.speaker: char_KUWAGAMON
lines.text:
You think? I'm more of a "charge in first, ask questions 
later" kind of 'mon.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The way you keep foes away from your allies.

lines.speaker: char_KUWAGAMON
lines.text: True. Hiding behind me is one of the safest places to be.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That unyielding fighting spirit.

lines.speaker: char_KUWAGAMON
lines.text:
To protect what needs to be protected, you need a heart 
that's stronger than anything.

lines.speaker: char_TYRANTKABUTERIMON
lines.text: I am the Monarch of the Insects!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I acknowledge your strength.

lines.speaker: char_TYRANTKABUTERIMON
lines.text:
Bow in veneration to the glory of my impenetrable 
Chrondigizoid shell.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: So you control Insectoid Digimon directly?

lines.speaker: char_TYRANTKABUTERIMON
lines.text: Remember this! A monarch never handles such matters personally.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: But we're still friends, right?

lines.speaker: char_TYRANTKABUTERIMON
lines.text:
Of course. You should be honored to count such a valiant warrior 
among your friends.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's what I love about you.

lines.speaker: char_TYRANTKABUTERIMON
lines.text: A monarch is beloved by all.

lines.speaker: char_LOTOSMON
lines.text: Is the aura I emit too bright for you?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yes, but I'll try to handle it...!

lines.speaker: char_LOTOSMON
lines.text:
No need to force yourself. I shall invite you to a blessed world of 
illusion all the same.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Where does that aura come from?

lines.speaker: char_LOTOSMON
lines.text:
My power, one which bestows peaceful dreams that allow you 
to forget your cares.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Give me some of that sheen, why don't you?

lines.speaker: char_LOTOSMON
lines.text: Take as much as you like. All I desire is your happiness.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I can't get enough of that gleam.

lines.speaker: char_LOTOSMON
lines.text:
I am glad. Continue to gaze upon me, and I shall grant all the 
happy dreams you like.

lines.speaker: char_PALMON
lines.text: Even if it's hot and bright, I love me some strong sunshine!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's shine even brighter!

lines.speaker: char_PALMON
lines.text:
Yeah, of course! The more Mister Sun shines down on us,
