the better we'll be!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sure helps with the photosynthesis, I bet.

lines.speaker: char_PALMON
lines.text: Uh-huh. And I hope I make you tons of fresh oxygen to breathe!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How's your UV protection?

lines.speaker: char_PALMON
lines.text:
Never you fear about me. Just make sure not to get too much 
direct sunlight yourself.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not loving the idea of a sunburn.

lines.speaker: char_PALMON
lines.text:
You may dread the thought, but not me. All that sun makes 
for some fine photosynthesis!

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON_BM
lines.text: Love or beauty, which do you desire?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't need either.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON_BM
lines.text:
Surely that is nothing more than bravado. One can't live with 
neither love nor beauty.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want both.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON_BM
lines.text:
First, think long and hard about what you need to fulfill that 
insatiable desire.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want beauty.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON_BM
lines.text: Then I will give it to you—in exchange for your love.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want love.

lines.speaker: char_ROSEMON_BM
lines.text: Then I will give it to you—in exchange for your beauty.

lines.speaker: char_HAGURUMON
lines.text: Gigigi! Gigigigi!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Wait. Does that mean you wanna fight?

lines.speaker: char_HAGURUMON
lines.text:
Gigigi... While I do like cutting loose sometimes, I've got no beef 
with you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Isn't that a different sound from usual?

lines.speaker: char_HAGURUMON
lines.text:
Gigigi... Good for you for noticing. But I just need some exercise, 
so I was stretching.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Feeling under the weather?

lines.speaker: char_HAGURUMON
lines.text:
Gigigi! Is that how I look to you? I'm full of vim and vigor, let me 
tell you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you all right? Pull yourself together!

lines.speaker: char_HAGURUMON
lines.text:
Gigi, gigigi... I was, uh, just fixing my posture, is all. Sorry to 
worry you.

lines.speaker: char_GOTTSUMON
lines.text: What should we do for fun today?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Rock climbing.

lines.speaker: char_GOTTSUMON
lines.text: Fine with me, but it's gonna hurt if you fall!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Spelunking.

lines.speaker: char_GOTTSUMON
lines.text: I'm sick of rocks and boulders, but if you wanna do it, then let's go!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Play tag.

lines.speaker: char_GOTTSUMON
lines.text: Okay, but you're it!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Go on a date.

lines.speaker: char_GOTTSUMON
lines.text: ...Oh, I was just thinkin' that'd be fun, too.

lines.speaker: char_ARMADILLOMON
lines.text: I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Eating too much is bad for you.

lines.speaker: char_ARMADILLOMON
lines.text: Mind your own business!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A balanced diet is important.

lines.speaker: char_ARMADILLOMON
lines.text: And quantity is better than quality.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Wanna munch on something together?

lines.speaker: char_ARMADILLOMON
lines.text: That'd be great!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Want some ChuuChuu Jelly?

lines.speaker: char_ARMADILLOMON
lines.text: Now you're talkin'! You know what I like.

lines.speaker: char_KOKUWAMON
lines.text: You all had better appreciate the electricity you got.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Back at you! Watch what you discharge!

lines.speaker: char_KOKUWAMON
lines.text: Oh! Yeah... I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I use renewable energy myself.

lines.speaker: char_KOKUWAMON
lines.text: I don't get it, but sounds awesome!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Gimme some of your juice.

lines.speaker: char_KOKUWAMON
lines.text: That's not really my specialty.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I keep my energy consumption to a minimum.

lines.speaker: char_KOKUWAMON
lines.text: Glad to hear it. I'll do my part, too!

lines.speaker: char_GUARDROMON
lines.text: When it comes down to it, just leave the fighting to me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Hey, that's my line.

lines.speaker: char_GUARDROMON
lines.text:
Too good for me, huh? Still, you seem like someone I can
count on.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's come up with a strategy first.

lines.speaker: char_GUARDROMON
lines.text: That sounds good. I'm big on planning, myself.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: When it's time to fight, we fight together.

lines.speaker: char_GUARDROMON
lines.text: Suit yourself, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't overdo it, now.

lines.speaker: char_GUARDROMON
lines.text: Back at you.

lines.speaker: char_TANKMON
lines.text: Dagnabbit! I'm just itching to run wild!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Want me to take you on?

lines.speaker: char_TANKMON
lines.text: You're on! ...Hah! As if! Why would I ever throw down with you?!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You should prepare for your next fight.

lines.speaker: char_TANKMON
lines.text:
Hey, I'm more than good to go, you know! Battle ready, 
any day of the week!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet that's driving you crazy, huh?

lines.speaker: char_TANKMON
lines.text: I want to find someplace with a battle raging. Anywhere will do!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You deserve to relax a little more.

lines.speaker: char_TANKMON
lines.text: Nice of you to say, but relaxing just gets me ready to snooze...

lines.speaker: char_TUCHIDARUMON
lines.text: Why's everyone always trying to fight?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Because they're strong?

lines.speaker: char_TUCHIDARUMON
lines.text: In that case, why don't they just arm wrestle or something?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Because they're weak?

lines.speaker: char_TUCHIDARUMON
lines.text: In that case, why don't they just work out or something?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Because they like it?

lines.speaker: char_TUCHIDARUMON
lines.text: Welp, nothing I can say about that, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Because they're lonely?

lines.speaker: char_TUCHIDARUMON
lines.text: In that case, why don't they just let me be their friend?

lines.speaker: char_ANKYLOMON
lines.text: I'm the hardest and heaviest of 'em all!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't you think you eat too much?

lines.speaker: char_ANKYLOMON
lines.text:
Can't get a bod like mine by sweatin' that stuff!
I chow down all I want!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Do you have trouble moving around?

lines.speaker: char_ANKYLOMON
lines.text: I can charge and jump with the best of 'em! Watch and learn, kid!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Maybe you should lose some weight.

lines.speaker: char_ANKYLOMON
lines.text: Don't you worry. I'm at my bulky best!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Cool!

lines.speaker: char_ANKYLOMON
lines.text: Just you wait till I Digivolve. Then I'll be even cooler!

lines.speaker: char_CLOCKMON
lines.text: You got any time to spare?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't have any to give.

lines.speaker: char_CLOCKMON
lines.text:
You seem like a stickler when it comes to time. But that's not
a bad thing.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I do if you pay me back later.

lines.speaker: char_CLOCKMON
lines.text: You're really on top of it. I like people who value their time.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's both make time for each other.

lines.speaker: char_CLOCKMON
lines.text:
When you say it like that, it sounds like I'll need to give some
of my time, too.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll always make time for the two of us.

lines.speaker: char_CLOCKMON
lines.text:
Well, what a nice thing to say. I'll give you my time, too,
someday.

lines.speaker: char_MAMEMON
lines.text: I want to be big. I mean REAL big!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Small and strong is good enough, isn't it?

lines.speaker: char_MAMEMON
lines.text:
I'd love to be big and strong, but I guess I can start with the 
"strong" part!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Big is just easier for enemies to spot.

lines.speaker: char_MAMEMON
lines.text: Huh! I guess you're right! I'm glad I'm a shrimp!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your size is part of the Mamemon charm!

lines.speaker: char_MAMEMON
lines.text:
Huh. I guess I wouldn't be the Mamemon you all know and love 
if I were big, would I?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Smaller is cuter, you know.

lines.speaker: char_MAMEMON
lines.text: Y-You really think so? Hehe!

lines.speaker: char_METALMAMEMON
lines.text: I'm 90% machine now. Isn't that cool?!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Depends on how strong you are.

lines.speaker: char_METALMAMEMON
lines.text:
My strength is nothing to sneeze at, of course. I want to show 
you how cool I can be!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Coolness is all about skills.

lines.speaker: char_METALMAMEMON
lines.text:
Then I'm plenty cool! My Energy Bomb has awesome destructive
power!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A mechanical body's so cool!

lines.speaker: char_METALMAMEMON
lines.text: You can take a closer look, if you want!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're cool, with or without machinery.

lines.speaker: char_METALMAMEMON
lines.text:
Really? You mean, like, cool on the inside?! That makes me
so happy!

lines.speaker: char_ANDROMON
lines.text: ALL WHO STAND IN OUR PATH SHALL BE ELIMINATED.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's the spirit!

lines.speaker: char_ANDROMON
lines.text: LEAVE THE REST UP TO ME.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: char_ANDROMON
lines.text: "OVERDOING IT" IS NOT PART OF MY PROGRAMMING.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sometimes it's important to talk things out.

lines.speaker: char_ANDROMON
lines.text: I WILL LEAVE THOSE SITUATIONS TO YOU.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What about "Love thy neighbor"?

lines.speaker: char_ANDROMON
lines.text: ...I WILL TRY.

lines.speaker: char_HIANDROMON
lines.text: Will there be any chance to use my Atomic Ray?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sure. Keep it always ready to fire.

lines.speaker: char_HIANDROMON
lines.text: Understood. I will be ready to fight anytime!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd like to avoid it, if possible.

lines.speaker: char_HIANDROMON
lines.text: In that case, I shall simply judge by the flow of each battle.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sure, when it's time to help our allies.

lines.speaker: char_HIANDROMON
lines.text: Understood. I shall protect our allies to the end!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sure, when it's time to save our loved ones.

lines.speaker: char_HIANDROMON
lines.text: Understood. You are the only one I would consider a loved one.

lines.speaker: char_MUGENDRAMON
lines.text: DO YOU WANT TO SEE AN EXAMPLE OF UNLIMITED STRENGTH?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sure! I wanna see unlimited strength.

lines.speaker: char_MUGENDRAMON
lines.text: THEN LOOK IN FRONT OF YOU. I AM THAT EXAMPLE.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is it you? What makes you so strong?

lines.speaker: char_MUGENDRAMON
lines.text:
I HAVE THE STRONGEST PARTS, DIGICORE AND PROGRAMMING. 
THEY GRANT ME INFINITE POWER.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna see limitless friendship.

lines.speaker: char_MUGENDRAMON
lines.text:
IF YOU ACCEPT ME, I WILL ALWAYS OFFER YOU MY 
UNWAVERING SUPPORT.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna see never-ending love.

lines.speaker: char_MUGENDRAMON
lines.text: IF YOU ASK IT OF ME, I SHALL PROVIDE IT FOREVERMORE.

lines.speaker: char_MEGAGROWLMON
lines.text: Leave any aerial assaults to me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna fly with you!

lines.speaker: char_MEGAGROWLMON
lines.text:
Just fly? I bet the idea of fighting will pique your interest once 
you are up there.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How can you fly with such a huge body?

lines.speaker: char_MEGAGROWLMON
lines.text:
The vernier thrusters on my shoulders. I doubt anyone but me 
could control this power.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's try joint assaults together.

lines.speaker: char_MEGAGROWLMON
lines.text:
No need for you to lift a finger. I have more than enough power 
on my own.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I won't let you do anything reckless.

lines.speaker: char_MEGAGROWLMON
lines.text:
Your concern is unwarranted. The power within me is much 
greater than you think.

lines.speaker: char_ULTIMATEBRAKIMON
lines.text: I'm the most gargantuan Digimon on land.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your bulk is a little intimidating.

lines.speaker: char_ULTIMATEBRAKIMON
lines.text: No need to fear me, but do be careful not to get trampled underfoot.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How did you even get that huge?

lines.speaker: char_ULTIMATEBRAKIMON
lines.text:
Repeated remodeling, I suppose? In any case, reaching my
size would probably be impossible for most.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want you to get even bigger.

lines.speaker: char_ULTIMATEBRAKIMON
lines.text:
I'd have trouble moving if I got bigger, but, with your 
support, maybe I could pull it off.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let me ride on your back!

lines.speaker: char_ULTIMATEBRAKIMON
lines.text: Fine by me. Just don't scald yourself with my boosters, okay?

lines.speaker: char_MERAMON
lines.text: I'm on FIRE, baby!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's flare up together.

lines.speaker: char_MERAMON
lines.text: Nice! I like it! But be sure you don't get burned.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What fuels your fire?

lines.speaker: char_MERAMON
lines.text: Why, me, of course! I can keep this fire burning forever and ever!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Burn even brighter!

lines.speaker: char_MERAMON
lines.text: Heck, yeah! I'm a raging blaze!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Careful not to overdo it.

lines.speaker: char_MERAMON
lines.text:
Appreciate the thought! But this flame ain't even CLOSE to 
my max, pal!

lines.speaker: char_BOTAMON
lines.text: Bloob, bloob!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You wanna help?

lines.speaker: char_BOTAMON
lines.text: Sure! I'll do my best, too!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm trying to study...

lines.speaker: char_BOTAMON
lines.text: Teach me, too.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm counting on you!

lines.speaker: char_BOTAMON
lines.text: I'm counting on you, too!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's be friends.

lines.speaker: char_BOTAMON
lines.text: Friends forever!

lines.speaker: char_PUNIMON
lines.text: Puni, puniii!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Do you wanna go somewhere?

lines.speaker: char_PUNIMON
lines.text: Together, with you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What's your name?

lines.speaker: char_PUNIMON
lines.text: Me, Punimon!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're a good kid.

lines.speaker: char_PUNIMON
lines.text: Me, good kid!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're so cute!

lines.speaker: char_PUNIMON
lines.text: Me, so happy!

lines.speaker: char_KOROMON
lines.text: I wanna fight, too! Like, right now!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna send you into battle soon.

lines.speaker: char_KOROMON
lines.text:
First, I've gotta Digivolve into a stronger form, right? I'll do my 
best, so cheer me on!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You oughta watch some battles first.

lines.speaker: char_KOROMON
lines.text:
I've been watching a whole bunch! I'm practically an expert 
at this point.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Easy does it, now.

lines.speaker: char_KOROMON
lines.text: All right. If you say so! Boy, you're a kind person, aren't you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't wanna have you fight just yet.

lines.speaker: char_KOROMON
lines.text:
Fine, then. I'll give up on the idea for now. You really know me 
pretty well, don't you!

lines.speaker: char_TUNOMON
lines.text: Is my horn cool, or is my horn cool?!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's a little scary.

lines.speaker: char_TUNOMON
lines.text:
Man, I must be pretty awesome if I can scare you. I'm gonna 
scare you some more!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's a little... iffy.

lines.speaker: char_TUNOMON
lines.text: Iffy? What do you mean by "iffy"? Come on! You can tell me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It looks really strong.

lines.speaker: char_TUNOMON
lines.text: What? It does?! That makes me pretty giddy! I'm not gonna lie.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's cool as heck!

lines.speaker: char_TUNOMON
lines.text:
Appreciate it! I ought to Digivolve real soon, so I can get even
cooler.

lines.speaker: char_KOTEMON
lines.text:
If you wish to get stronger, I'd be more than happy to train you. 
What say you?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Train me, please!

lines.speaker: char_KOTEMON
lines.text: That's the spirit! Learn all the techniques you can from me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How can I get stronger?

lines.speaker: char_KOTEMON
lines.text: Training is the only way, I'm afraid. Still, strength isn't everything.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't feel like training...

lines.speaker: char_KOTEMON
lines.text:
Yet training provides such unique insights! Perhaps even a way 
to read your opponent.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Strength isn't everything.

lines.speaker: char_KOTEMON
lines.text: Well said. As long as those words aren't simply sour grapes.

lines.speaker: char_V-MON
lines.text: I wanna do more for you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Get even stronger, then.

lines.speaker: char_V-MON
lines.text: You're right. First, I've gotta get stronger and Digivolve!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't wanna depend on others too much.

lines.speaker: char_V-MON
lines.text: You being so brave like that just makes me wanna help you more.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just you saying that is more than enough.

lines.speaker: char_V-MON
lines.text: I'm glad you and I are friends!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're doing just fine now.

lines.speaker: char_V-MON
lines.text: Okay, then I'm gonna keep going with my training, so just you watch!

lines.speaker: char_GAOMON
lines.text: Hey, how goes it?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No problems to report.

lines.speaker: char_GAOMON
lines.text: Okay, then time for another full-throttle day!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Feeling great!

lines.speaker: char_GAOMON
lines.text:
I shoulda known. I gotta stay more on top of my health game, 
like you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can't you see for yourself?

lines.speaker: char_GAOMON
lines.text: Yeah, of course I can!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not too great.

lines.speaker: char_GAOMON
lines.text: Gotta make sure to take breaks every now and then, huh?

lines.speaker: char_FALCOMON
lines.text: Soaring through the sky feels amazing!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna fly with you.

lines.speaker: char_FALCOMON
lines.text: If only you had wings like me, huh?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: char_FALCOMON
lines.text: Huh? You've flown before? No way.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Running on the ground feels great, too.

lines.speaker: char_FALCOMON
lines.text: Take me with you sometime!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I can't do heights.

lines.speaker: char_FALCOMON
lines.text: Must be tough being human.

lines.speaker: char_GARGOMON
lines.text: Which is faster, running or flying?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Both are fast.

lines.speaker: char_GARGOMON
lines.text:
I feel the same way. I want to get good at both so I don't have to 
worry about choosing.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I couldn't say.

lines.speaker: char_GARGOMON
lines.text:
Okay, then take notes next time I run and next time I fly and 
let's compare.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Running is faster.

lines.speaker: char_GARGOMON
lines.text:
I'd win a race against you... But just running together sounds like 
it'd be fun.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Flying is faster.

lines.speaker: char_GARGOMON
lines.text:
It seems that way since you can't fly, but slow is better when 
hanging out in the sky.

lines.speaker: char_GAOGAMON
lines.text: Not good enough! I gotta have more!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What do you need more of?

lines.speaker: char_GAOGAMON
lines.text: Power, speed and fighting spirit. Help me get into gear!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're plenty strong.

lines.speaker: char_GAOGAMON
lines.text:
Don't try to console me. Or maybe you're trying to show me 
another tactic...?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're more than cool enough.

lines.speaker: char_GAOGAMON
lines.text: Well, that really takes the wind outta my sails. You win.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Time for some special training.

lines.speaker: char_GAOGAMON
lines.text: You're gonna join me? I knew I could count on you!

lines.speaker: char_PARROTMON
lines.text: Which color do you prefer, red, blue, yellow or green?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Blue.

lines.speaker: char_PARROTMON
lines.text:
You like the shade of my legs? Some fear the hue thanks to
these sharp talons, but not you, no.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Red...

lines.speaker: char_PARROTMON
lines.text:
You like the tint of my crest? You must be intrigued by the 
lightning it shoots, too.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yellow?

lines.speaker: char_PARROTMON
lines.text:
You like my wings' hue? If you can take it, I'll show you how 
they shine at sonic speed.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Green!

lines.speaker: char_PARROTMON
lines.text:
You like the tone of my body? I bet you hold the trees of the 
forest dear as well.

lines.speaker: char_ZUDOMON
lines.text: Check out these muscles!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Too hardcore for me.

lines.speaker: char_ZUDOMON
lines.text: Only an adult could understand the value of muscles like these.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wish I had a body like yours.

lines.speaker: char_ZUDOMON
lines.text: Then you'd better hit the gym, pal.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Those sure are some awesome muscles!

lines.speaker: char_ZUDOMON
lines.text: Drink them in. I don't mind.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna touch them.

lines.speaker: char_ZUDOMON
lines.text: ...Just a little would be fine, I guess.

lines.speaker: char_PICKLEMON
lines.text: I'm gonna prank you good if you don't train properly!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll start now.

lines.speaker: char_PICKLEMON
lines.text: For real? I'm keeping my eye on you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm taking it seriously. Promise.

lines.speaker: char_PICKLEMON
lines.text: Amazing! Glad to hear it. I look forward to seeing the results!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nuh-uh. Don't wanna.

lines.speaker: char_PICKLEMON
lines.text: You're slacking off! Look out, because I'm gonna prank you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: If you're gonna prank me, then prank me.

lines.speaker: char_PICKLEMON
lines.text: Hehehe... Oh, this is gonna be good.

lines.speaker: char_BEARMON
lines.text: C'mon. Let's play!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's spar.

lines.speaker: char_BEARMON
lines.text: But that's training! You really are serious about stuff, huh?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's talk.

lines.speaker: char_BEARMON
lines.text: Okay, that works, too. I love listening to you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's have a race.

lines.speaker: char_BEARMON
lines.text: I'm not very fast, but you'll never beat me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's play tag.

lines.speaker: char_BEARMON
lines.text:
Okay, then I'll be it. We could play hide and seek, but I know
I'd find you right away!

lines.speaker: char_SHOUTMON
lines.text: You wanna hear my song, or what?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Crank it up to eleven.

lines.speaker: char_SHOUTMON
lines.text:
All right! I'm gonna shout at full blast! Get ready, or I'll knock ya 
off your feet!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Use your inside voice, please.

lines.speaker: char_SHOUTMON
lines.text:
You want a nice li'l listening party, do ya? Okay, I'll burn my ditty 
into your brain.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How about a song and a dance?

lines.speaker: char_SHOUTMON
lines.text: If ya insist, then I'll put on a show! A live performance, just for you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's make it a duet!

lines.speaker: char_SHOUTMON
lines.text:
I won't lend ya the mic, but you can sing your heart out! This is
our harmony, baby!

lines.speaker: char_RENAMON
lines.text: Who would you say is a truly strong Digimon?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I couldn't say.

lines.speaker: char_RENAMON
lines.text:
Nor could I, but if I keep on beating strong Digimon, I'm sure 
I'll figure it out someday.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wouldn't say it was you.

lines.speaker: char_RENAMON
lines.text:
That's understandable. This world is full of Digimon I've never 
laid eyes on, after all.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You, for sure.

lines.speaker: char_RENAMON
lines.text:
Thank you. Having felled strong Digimon and copied their 
data, I am undoubtably strong.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It could be practically any one of them.

lines.speaker: char_RENAMON
lines.text:
I see. Well, no matter what strong Digimon I end up facing, 
I hope you will back me up.

lines.speaker: char_PANJYAMON
lines.text: Don't you like the cold?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not crazy about it.

lines.speaker: char_PANJYAMON
lines.text:
Then you ought to train in the polar frost. You'll get used to it
for sure.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm fine with it.

lines.speaker: char_PANJYAMON
lines.text: Just make sure you can still say that even in the arctic chill.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't mind, as long as I've got my friends.

lines.speaker: char_PANJYAMON
lines.text: I'm glad to hear that.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It'd be nice if you'd keep me warm!

lines.speaker: char_PANJYAMON
lines.text:
If you mean keeping warm with some warmups together, then 
I'd do it gladly.

lines.speaker: char_MACHGAOGAMON
lines.text: I have confidence in my thrusters.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Show me, then.

lines.speaker: char_MACHGAOGAMON
lines.text: This isn't exactly the best place to ignite my rocket engines...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Rocket engines are risky business.

lines.speaker: char_MACHGAOGAMON
lines.text: Never you fear. I've got full control over them. You'll see.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can't wait to see what you can do with them.

lines.speaker: char_MACHGAOGAMON
lines.text:
I won't let you down. These rocket engines are like an extension 
of my own body.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Careful with them, now.

lines.speaker: char_MACHGAOGAMON
lines.text:
I appreciate your concern. Looking forward to the chance to 
show them off!

lines.speaker: char_GAZIMON
lines.text: No human is ever gonna tame me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Oh, I'm gonna. Just you wait.

lines.speaker: char_GAZIMON
lines.text: Tough talk. I look forward to seeing you try!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're already tamed.

lines.speaker: char_GAZIMON
lines.text: N-No, I'm not! Explain to me exactly how it is I'm tamed?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd never think of trying to.

lines.speaker: char_GAZIMON
lines.text: Ha! I see you get it. You're in for lots of friendly pranks!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want you to tame me.

lines.speaker: char_GAZIMON
lines.text:
Wh-What the...? I didn't expect that. A tame human might not
be all that bad, though...

lines.speaker: char_BETAMON
lines.text: How awesome is my million-volt Electric Shock?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: High-voltage power lines carry 6,600 volts.

lines.speaker: char_BETAMON
lines.text:
So Electric Shock is stronger, even though power lines are
way bigger then me? Wow!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Batteries have 1.5 volts.

lines.speaker: char_BETAMON
lines.text:
Hey, so if I wanted to power my move with batteries, how
many would I need, huh? Huh?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Lightning is one hundred million volts.

lines.speaker: char_BETAMON
lines.text:
Whoa! Didn't know lightning was that amazing. I got a ways 
to go... Cheer me on, okay?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: An electrical outlet has one hundred volts.

lines.speaker: char_BETAMON
lines.text:
So Electric Shock can't help around your house, huh? Don't
kick me out, though, okay?

lines.speaker: char_GIZAMON
lines.text: I wanna go swimming.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I can't swim.

lines.speaker: char_GIZAMON
lines.text: Then I'll teach you. Might be tough since you don't have fins, though.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Well, I don't.

lines.speaker: char_GIZAMON
lines.text:
I figured... But hopping around on land makes me tired, so
teach me how to move easier.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.speaker: char_GIZAMON
lines.text:
Uh, really? You do know nobody can beat me in the water, right? 
I'm not kidding!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Be patient.

lines.speaker: char_GIZAMON
lines.text:
I am, because I wanna hang out with you. It's just... 
everything's way easier in the water!

lines.speaker: char_TYRANNOMON
lines.text: Have my claws gotten a little too long?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yeah, they're too long.

lines.speaker: char_TYRANNOMON
lines.text:
I haven't whipped out Slash Claw much these days. Better put
these bad boys to good use!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd say they're too short.

lines.speaker: char_TYRANNOMON
lines.text: What? You sure? Guess it's hard to tell on my own. I'm glad I asked!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nah, they're just right.

lines.speaker: char_TYRANNOMON
lines.text:
Must be my imagination, then. Okay! Now I feel like slashing 
something up!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I didn't even notice.

lines.speaker: char_TYRANNOMON
lines.text:
Guess it doesn't matter in a scrap, huh? Still, I wish you paid 
closer attention...

lines.speaker: char_AIRDRAMON
lines.text: Would you like me to give you a ride somewhere?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Take me somewhere I've never been before.

lines.speaker: char_AIRDRAMON
lines.text:
You feel that much at ease with me, do you...? I'll 
consider it, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna go somewhere far away.

lines.speaker: char_AIRDRAMON
lines.text:
You and I have different ideas of what "far" is, so we should 
probably define that first.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't wanna go anywhere.

lines.speaker: char_AIRDRAMON
lines.text:
Perhaps I was mistaken. But you should know that 
flying feels wonderful.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't want a ride.

lines.speaker: char_AIRDRAMON
lines.text:
Well, if the day ever comes that you need my aid, all you need 
to do is ask.

lines.speaker: char_POYOMON
lines.text: Poyo, poyooo!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Pull yourself together!

lines.speaker: char_POYOMON
lines.text: Me, no lose!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're doing really well.

lines.speaker: char_POYOMON
lines.text: Me, good 'mon!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Poyomon, was it?

lines.speaker: char_POYOMON
lines.text: Me, friend!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I love you, Poyomon!

lines.speaker: char_POYOMON
lines.text: Me, love you, too!

lines.speaker: char_TOKOMON
lines.text: I wanna Digivolve fast into something real tough!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're already strong, you know.

lines.speaker: char_TOKOMON
lines.text: That's right! I chomp down on my foes real good!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You've got my support!

lines.speaker: char_TOKOMON
lines.text: Teach me, teach me, pretty please!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're nice and cute the way you are.

lines.speaker: char_TOKOMON
lines.text:
Really? Then maybe I won't Digivolve after all... Aw, but 
I really want to!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You'd better get a cool look, too!

lines.speaker: char_TOKOMON
lines.text:
If my Digivolution makes me stronger, that's cool enough for me. 
Heck, I'm cool already!

lines.speaker: char_PATAMON
lines.text:
You have to apologize when you do something wrong, and 
apologize well... right?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: char_PATAMON
lines.text:
...I knew it. I'd better work up the courage to apologize. 
Sorry for the weird question.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Did you do something wrong?

lines.speaker: char_PATAMON
lines.text:
No! ...Well, okay, I guess I do have some regrets. Thanks for 
making me realize that.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Did someone do something to you?

lines.speaker: char_PATAMON
lines.text: No biggie. It's already over and done with. Sorry for worrying you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll apologize on their behalf.

lines.speaker: char_PATAMON
lines.text:
You sure are nice, aren't you? In that case, I'll go ahead and 
forgive you.

lines.speaker: char_KUDAMON
lines.text: Riding on a human's shoulders sure is relaxing!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet you're real heavy.

lines.speaker: char_KUDAMON
lines.text:
That's just not true. Humans seem pleased to have me ride on 
them. You should try it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't go clambering on me.

lines.speaker: char_KUDAMON
lines.text:
I pick and choose my rides, thank you. Whether I'll ride you is 
still up in the air.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Hop on up, then. I'll give you a ride.

lines.speaker: char_KUDAMON
lines.text:
I appreciate the thought. Still, I need to get to know you better, 
or I can't relax.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not sit on their lap?

lines.speaker: char_KUDAMON
lines.text:
That's hardly the same, now, is it? I prefer the sensation of 
moving around with humans.

lines.speaker: char_PLOTMON
lines.text: Say, what's a "puppy"?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A mischievous little critter.

lines.speaker: char_PLOTMON
lines.text:
Aw, what a shame! People say I look like one. If I ever spot one, 
I'm going to scold it!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A lifeform that looks like you.

lines.speaker: char_PLOTMON
lines.text: Humans say that a lot, yeah. I'm real curious to know what they're like!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: An animal beloved by many.

lines.speaker: char_PLOTMON
lines.text:
People say I look like one. I guess that's why humans are 
always so nice to me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A creature that's cute as a button!

lines.speaker: char_PLOTMON
lines.text:
Cute?! I'm told I look like one a lot, you know. What a nice 
thing to say!

lines.speaker: char_TERRIERMON
lines.text: We ought to take things more easy-breezy.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd say we need to get more serious.

lines.speaker: char_TERRIERMON
lines.text:
You're something else, aren't you? Still, don't go wearing yourself
out, now.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm already easy-breezy, baby!

lines.speaker: char_TERRIERMON
lines.text:
Not from where I'm standing, but if you say so. I'll try to follow 
your example.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A little earnestness never hurt anyone.

lines.speaker: char_TERRIERMON
lines.text:
Ease and earnestness are two sides of the same coin, y'know? 
I'm the perfect example.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Aren't you a little too easy-going?

lines.speaker: char_TERRIERMON
lines.text:
Too much is just right for yours truly. You really know how to 
compliment a 'mon!

lines.speaker: char_LOPMON
lines.text: I'm... I'm not a crybaby, you know!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're the dictionary definition of one.

lines.speaker: char_LOPMON
lines.text:
I told you I'm not, but you... You...! *sniff* I won't cry, darn it! 
You hear me?!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Only crybabies say they're not crybabies.

lines.speaker: char_LOPMON
lines.text:
I see. So that's how it is... I'll strike the word from my vocabulary, 
then, starting now!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: In that case, don't cry.

lines.speaker: char_LOPMON
lines.text:
Okay. I won't cry... I'm not crying right now, am I? That means 
I'm cured! Right?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Who said you were a crybaby?

lines.speaker: char_LOPMON
lines.text:
Thanks for believing me! I bet no one'd call me that if you'd 
been around from the get-go.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEMON
lines.text: I will not allow even the smallest of misdeeds to go unpunished.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sorry for stealing your snacks.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEMON
lines.text:
I applaud you for having the courage to confess. However, 
never do it again.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can't you give me a pass?

lines.speaker: char_ANGEMON
lines.text:
If you can exercise guile, you should never have dabbled in 
wickedness to begin with.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sorry about all the farts.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEMON
lines.text: ...Please do not bother me with such banal antics.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: My conscience is clean.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEMON
lines.text: And this is why you of all humans have my trust. Most admirable.

lines.speaker: char_REPPAMON
lines.text:
Hey, pal! Where are you looking?! Over here! The tail is the 
one that's Reppamon!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not the head part?

lines.speaker: char_REPPAMON
lines.text:
Wrong! I'm the one that cuts and cleaves. The head is just 
spineless window dressing!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The tail? Isn't that part just the blade?

lines.speaker: char_REPPAMON
lines.text:
That "just the blade" part you so glibly refer to is me, Reppamon! 
Get it straight!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Whatever. It's all the same to me.

lines.speaker: char_REPPAMON
lines.text:
Look. I'm just a tail, with a body and head hanging off me 
like a tail. Get it?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Aren't both of you Reppamon, a 2-in-1 deal?

lines.speaker: char_REPPAMON
lines.text:
Hey, if it were up to me, I'd just cut the other part off. 
But, sure. Have it your way.

lines.speaker: char_TAILMON
lines.text: I want you to make full use of the power of my Holy Ring.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd rather not use it if I don't have to.

lines.speaker: char_TAILMON
lines.text:
You probably wouldn't have to if things stay peaceful—but that's 
an even taller order.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wouldn't even know how to use it.

lines.speaker: char_TAILMON
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll teach you the ins and outs of the whole thing.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Thanks. I bet it'll be very useful.

lines.speaker: char_TAILMON
lines.text: I'm glad! It's important to have each other's backs.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just make sure you don't lose it!

lines.speaker: char_TAILMON
lines.text:
Thanks. But if things ever get dicey, I know you'll be there 
to protect me.

lines.speaker: char_YUNIMON
lines.text: Let's travel around the world together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wouldn't be able to keep up.

lines.speaker: char_YUNIMON
lines.text:
Don't be a scaredy-cat! Besides, I can help you if you fall
behind.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can humans fly, too?

lines.speaker: char_YUNIMON
lines.text:
Not unassisted, no. But with the right knowledge, anything
is possible.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to be able to fly.

lines.speaker: char_YUNIMON
lines.text:
Impossible without wings. Luckily, you have me to act as
your wings.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's go right away!

lines.speaker: char_YUNIMON
lines.text:
It isn't that simple. We can't let our excitement get the
better of us, here.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEWOMON
lines.text: One must right the world's wrongs, condoning no evil.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll help you do that.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEWOMON
lines.text:
I want you to be the nucleus of our efforts. Thus it is I who 
should be helping you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I feel the same way.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEWOMON
lines.text:
If we each act thoughtfully and do good, the world will move 
in the right direction.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna be someone like that.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEWOMON
lines.text: Each like-minded ally I can muster makes the world a better place.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I do that even when I'm by myself.

lines.speaker: char_ANGEWOMON
lines.text: I am here for you. I would never leave that burden to you alone.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYANGEMON
lines.text:
I walk the path of righteousness. Will you move forward
together with me on this path?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not sure I'm up to it.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYANGEMON
lines.text:
In that case, I insist we walk it together. You can start by
overcoming your own fears.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yes, I'd like to.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYANGEMON
lines.text:
If your determination is set, the path ahead shall open. Then
shall the learning begin!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I will. I have to!

lines.speaker: char_HOLYANGEMON
lines.text:
That is what it means to be with me. I am pleased to see you 
understand as much.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd like you to follow me, actually.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYANGEMON
lines.text:
I had hoped you would take the lead one day. I am pleased that 
today is that day.

lines.speaker: char_KNIGHTMON
lines.text: I pledge my fealty to you, my liege.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: So if I told you to die for me, you'd do it?

lines.speaker: char_KNIGHTMON
lines.text:
My loyalty to you stems from faith that you would never bid me 
do something so egregious.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You'll obey my command without question?

lines.speaker: char_KNIGHTMON
lines.text:
Your orders are absolute. Please guide me, so that I may never 
stray from the path.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You and I should be on equal footing.

lines.speaker: char_KNIGHTMON
lines.text: I must be devoted to my liege. I have no desire to rise to your station.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I hope you come to like me.

lines.speaker: char_KNIGHTMON
lines.text:
But of course! And I hope my obedience is proof enough of 
that pledge.

lines.speaker: char_TYILINMON
lines.text: I would never condone pointless killing!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What exactly would you do about it?

lines.speaker: char_TYILINMON
lines.text: I would enact punishment! And do not think to interfere!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: But you would if there were a point to it?

lines.speaker: char_TYILINMON
lines.text:
Killing never has a point! All life in the Digital World must be 
met with compassion!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Would you ever show mercy?

lines.speaker: char_TYILINMON
lines.text: The offender must repent, and never take a life needlessly again.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Agreed.

lines.speaker: char_TYILINMON
lines.text: Killing is born of conflict. We must aspire to a world free of strife.

lines.speaker: char_GRADEMON
lines.text: Leave the vanguard to me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I can't do that.

lines.speaker: char_GRADEMON
lines.text:
I prefer to take the forefront myself, but for you, I can make 
an exception.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll think about it.

lines.speaker: char_GRADEMON
lines.text: I look forward to seeing what strategy you devise.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's all yours.

lines.speaker: char_GRADEMON
lines.text:
When the Golden Meteor charges forth, you will witness swordplay
of unparalleled speed.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just don't lose it when you fight.

lines.speaker: char_GRADEMON
lines.text:
Is that sarcasm? My swordplay is on par with a Holy Knight, but
I will accept your advice.

lines.speaker: char_CLAVISANGEMON
lines.text: You must remember to lock up everything.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll leave that to you.

lines.speaker: char_CLAVISANGEMON
lines.text:
I must safeguard the Zenith Gate. It is your responsibility to lock 
your own doors.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I worry about forgetting to lock up.

lines.speaker: char_CLAVISANGEMON
lines.text:
Then you must always double-check. It is even better to confirm
it out loud.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I always do.

lines.speaker: char_CLAVISANGEMON
lines.text: That is wonderful. If it ever comes to it, we can help each other.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna help.

lines.speaker: char_CLAVISANGEMON
lines.text:
I can handle the security of the Zenith Gate alone. But I appreciate 
the thought.

lines.speaker: char_OPHANIMON
lines.text:
I am a Super Angel, one of three Celestial Digimon guarding 
the Digital World's Kernel.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can I help you in any way?

lines.speaker: char_OPHANIMON
lines.text:
I would be happy if you spread word of my love and mercy 
throughout the Digital World.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What is your duty?

lines.speaker: char_OPHANIMON
lines.text:
My duty is to spread love and compassion throughout the 
Digital World. It is who I am.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What's a Super Angel?

lines.speaker: char_OPHANIMON
lines.text:
One of the roles among angels, and a Digimon type, much like 
"Insectoid" or "Reptile."

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is it okay for you to be here?

lines.speaker: char_OPHANIMON
lines.text:
My presence here means there is something for me to observe, 
and to accomplish.

lines.speaker: char_SERAPHIMON
lines.text: I am a Seraph Digimon, one who reigns over all Angel Digimon.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can I help you in any way?

lines.speaker: char_SERAPHIMON
lines.text: Do not allow evil to exist in this world.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Does that make you remarkable?

lines.speaker: char_SERAPHIMON
lines.text:
I am of the highest Angel Digimon echelon, yet that is simply 
the role bestowed upon me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What's a Seraph?

lines.speaker: char_SERAPHIMON
lines.text:
The greatest of all angels, they say. That does not change 
the fact that we are friends.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is it okay for you to be here?

lines.speaker: char_SERAPHIMON
lines.text:
I leave this place when the final battle is nigh. Until then, 
I shall stay with you.

lines.speaker: char_PEGASMON
lines.text:
Don't stand behind me. I won't be held responsible if you 
get a kick to the head.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Kick me if you need to.

lines.speaker: char_PEGASMON
lines.text:
Talk about asking for it... You'll change your tune once you 
see my Rodeo Gallop.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Would it really hurt that much?

lines.speaker: char_PEGASMON
lines.text:
"Hurt" wouldn't begin to describe it. Imagine it as a strike 
both brutal and true.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can I ride you?

lines.speaker: char_PEGASMON
lines.text:
I would prefer you didn't without reason, but for the right cause 
I would acquiesce.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't you do it, now.

lines.speaker: char_PEGASMON
lines.text:
It's a reflex, I assure you. Though perhaps your special presence 
would negate it?

lines.speaker: char_NEFERTIMON
lines.text: Allow me to enchant you with the light of my smile.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're not upset?

lines.speaker: char_NEFERTIMON
lines.text:
Such thoughts are proof of your impurity. One day, I shall 
purify you with my charm.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Wait. You're smiling?

lines.speaker: char_NEFERTIMON
lines.text: Wait. You cannot tell? One day, I shall purify you with my charm.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Oh, I'm enchanted.

lines.speaker: char_NEFERTIMON
lines.text: But of course. I have faith that you and I shall get along swimmingly.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I won't let you.

lines.speaker: char_NEFERTIMON
lines.text:
Other humans said the same, but they, too, were mesmerized. 
As you shall be, I am sure.

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAMON
lines.text: Do you believe in miracles?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I sure do!

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAMON
lines.text:
If there is any difficulty you wish to overcome, trust in me to 
see you through.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I mean, I'd like to...

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAMON
lines.text:
I sense hesitation within you. Stick with me, and one day 
you shall believe.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not a chance.

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAMON
lines.text:
The power of miracles is real. You must never give up, no matter 
how hard the situation.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I believe in you, Magnamon.

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAMON
lines.text:
That is good to hear. To believe in me is to believe in the power 
of miracles.

lines.speaker: char_CORONAMON
lines.text: Nobody's got more guts than me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What about stuff other than guts?

lines.speaker: char_CORONAMON
lines.text:
The sun is on my side, so my flames are unbeatable! Let's 
get out there and fight!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's impressive.

lines.speaker: char_CORONAMON
lines.text:
I know. It's always the guys with the least guts who say others 
don't have any.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's fight, then.

lines.speaker: char_CORONAMON
lines.text: Huh? But I wanted to be friends... We're in this together, right?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're a strong one.

lines.speaker: char_CORONAMON
lines.text: Thanks. So you respect me, huh? I respect you back.

lines.speaker: char_LUNAMON
lines.text: Hmm? Did you say something just now?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I was cheering you on!

lines.speaker: char_LUNAMON
lines.text:
I thought so! Figured you might be talking to someone else... 
Thanks! Let's do our best!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just talking to myself.

lines.speaker: char_LUNAMON
lines.text:
Yeah? Well, why not talk to me instead? I'm sure you've got 
tons to teach me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I didn't say anything.

lines.speaker: char_LUNAMON
lines.text:
I thought I heard your voice. My mistake. My hearing works 
against me sometimes...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I was just saying hello!

lines.speaker: char_LUNAMON
lines.text:
I thought so. Appreciate it! I was confident I could pick out 
your voice. I'm glad I did!

lines.speaker: char_ANCIENTWISETMON
lines.text:
I have been chronicling all wisdom since the distant past. 
Nothing is beyond my knowledge.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: So do you know what I'm thinking right now?

lines.speaker: char_ANCIENTWISETMON
lines.text:
That has nothing to do with wisdom. If you seek to test me, 
know that it is pointless.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna learn.

lines.speaker: char_ANCIENTWISETMON
lines.text:
I shall teach you what I can. To build the future, you must 
know the past.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's kind of scary.

lines.speaker: char_ANCIENTWISETMON
lines.text:
The wisdom I possess can discern the future. I shall not apply 
that same scrutiny to you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Wish I could be like that.

lines.speaker: char_ANCIENTWISETMON
lines.text:
Instead of wishing, I would have you learn from my wisdom 
and make it your own.

lines.speaker: char_SOLARMON
lines.text: Gigigi! Gigigigi!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're kinda hot, aren't you?

lines.speaker: char_SOLARMON
lines.text:
Gigigi... That's my hot DigiCore. Sorry for the stuffiness. Just
think of it as training!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you Hagurumon?

lines.speaker: char_SOLARMON
lines.text: Gigigi! I'm Solarmon, and don't you forget it!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your shine... It's almost angelic.

lines.speaker: char_SOLARMON
lines.text:
Gigi? You saying I'm divine or something? Come on. You're
gonna make me blush...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're looking red in the face today.

lines.speaker: char_SOLARMON
lines.text:
Gigi? Yeah, my face is always like this. Hope you're not mistaking 
me for someone else.

lines.speaker: char_BIRDRAMON
lines.text: Is there anything I can do for you?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Share some of your intensity with me.

lines.speaker: char_BIRDRAMON
lines.text: Intensity comes from within, so that's a task only you can complete.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna learn how to be calm like you.

lines.speaker: char_BIRDRAMON
lines.text:
Do I look calm to you? I'm merely thinking of what I can do
before the battle begins.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let me ride on you.

lines.speaker: char_BIRDRAMON
lines.text:
I wouldn't mind, but your posterior would catch fire. It may
be better to grab my legs.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna be with you forever.

lines.speaker: char_BIRDRAMON
lines.text:
Any strong desire is bound to come true. I shall remain with
you until the end of time.

lines.speaker: char_AGNIMON
lines.text: Flames obey my bidding.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You shouldn't burn things.

lines.speaker: char_AGNIMON
lines.text:
My flames are sacred, and only ever unleashed to cleanse 
evil from the Digital World.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can you incinerate garbage?

lines.speaker: char_AGNIMON
lines.text:
I can reduce anything to ash, but I must remain mindful 
of the environment.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can you put out fires, too?

lines.speaker: char_AGNIMON
lines.text:
That is a tall order... However, you have my word I shall deal
with any blazes I create.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can you heat up water?

lines.speaker: char_AGNIMON
lines.text:
There is nothing I cannot heat up. If it is hot water you desire, 
then it shall be done.

lines.speaker: char_VRITRAMON
lines.text: The flames of the fire dragon reduce all foes to ash!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Even the really, really big foes?

lines.speaker: char_VRITRAMON
lines.text:
The mightier the opponent, the brighter my fighting spirit 
burns—and my flames to match!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Even a whole slew of foes?

lines.speaker: char_VRITRAMON
lines.text:
I'll leave tactics to you. I don't care how bad things get in battle! 
I never back down!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You sure there's nothing left of them after?

lines.speaker: char_VRITRAMON
lines.text:
Shoot a laser that rivals the sun, and you won't find anything 
in its wake! Trust me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Well, what if they get away?

lines.speaker: char_VRITRAMON
lines.text:
That'll never happen. I'll whip up a blazing tornado with my flame 
wings to protect you!

lines.speaker: char_RIZEGREYMON
lines.text: I want to Digivolve and mechanize my entire body...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sounds like you'd get really strong.

lines.speaker: char_RIZEGREYMON
lines.text:
I think I'm pretty strong already, but I'd love to see just 
how powerful I could get.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're great the way you are.

lines.speaker: char_RIZEGREYMON
lines.text:
I like my body the way it is, but I've got to pursue any 
possibilities I can.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet you'd look cool as all get-out.

lines.speaker: char_RIZEGREYMON
lines.text:
Looks have nothing to do with it. I want to see just how 
strong I can get.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I like you, flesh and blood.

lines.speaker: char_RIZEGREYMON
lines.text:
So the look I used to have is superior? Not sure if that makes 
me happy or sad...

lines.speaker: char_SHAKKOUMON
lines.text: I SHALL PROTECT THIS LAND.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll leave it to you, then.

lines.speaker: char_SHAKKOUMON
lines.text: YES. REST ASSURED. I CAN ATTACK IN ALL DIRECTIONS.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nah. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: char_SHAKKOUMON
lines.text:
THAT WILL NOT DO. AS A GUARDIAN DEITY, I HAVE A DUTY 
TO PERFORM.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Looking forward to your protection.

lines.speaker: char_SHAKKOUMON
lines.text: IT IS MERELY THE DUTY OF A GUARDIAN DEITY.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: char_SHAKKOUMON
lines.text: I AM PLEASED TO RECEIVE YOUR THANKS.

lines.speaker: char_SHINEGREYMON
lines.text: Can anything win against the energy of the sun?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nope, not happening.

lines.speaker: char_SHINEGREYMON
lines.text: Exactly. None can compete with the blazing-hot energy of that star.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your power.

lines.speaker: char_SHINEGREYMON
lines.text:
True. Without my knowledge, it would be hard to convert the 
sun's power into my strength.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: My power.

lines.speaker: char_SHINEGREYMON
lines.text:
Putting aside whether you could beat the sun, I acknowledge
your abilities, my friend.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The power of friendship.

lines.speaker: char_SHINEGREYMON
lines.text:
True. The power of friends is nothing to scorn. They let me show 
the sun's true worth.

lines.speaker: char_HOUOUMON
lines.text: I must purge you of all evil!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't hurt me!

lines.speaker: char_HOUOUMON
lines.text:
With evil purged, pain and anguish will be gone forever. What
of a brief moment of pain?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Hold on!

lines.speaker: char_HOUOUMON
lines.text:
I cannot allow evil to thrive! Still, let us decide the best time to 
purge you together...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't purge me!

lines.speaker: char_HOUOUMON
lines.text:
Do you have a guilty conscience? If so, all the more reason to
do something about it!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Go ahead. Do it now!

lines.speaker: char_HOUOUMON
lines.text:
When the time comes, I shall purge you of evil with all haste. 
Leave that timing to me.

lines.speaker: char_MEGIDRAMON
lines.text:
Preaching the virtues of goodness to me would just be
wasted effort.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Even so, I'm still gonna advocate for it.

lines.speaker: char_MEGIDRAMON
lines.text:
It would amount to nothing, but you do say funny things. 
I applaud your pluck, at least.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: There must be good in you somewhere.

lines.speaker: char_MEGIDRAMON
lines.text:
I don't know what you're misunderstanding. Never
underestimate the power of darkness.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I agree wholeheartedly.

lines.speaker: char_MEGIDRAMON
lines.text: So, you get it, do you? Sensible human.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I feel sorry for you.

lines.speaker: char_MEGIDRAMON
lines.text:
Your attempt to grab my attention is pointless. You're the
pitiable one.

lines.speaker: char_BEOWOLFMON
lines.text: Which is superior, a wild nature or intelligence?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A wild nature.

lines.speaker: char_BEOWOLFMON
lines.text:
Yes, perhaps my wildness is the source of my unflinching 
fighting spirit.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Intelligence.

lines.speaker: char_BEOWOLFMON
lines.text:
Yes, my intellect may be where my firm resolve to fight for my
friends comes from.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: They're impossible to compare.

lines.speaker: char_BEOWOLFMON
lines.text:
Yes. A true warrior must balance a wild spirit with reason,
just as I do.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No use worrying about it.

lines.speaker: char_BEOWOLFMON
lines.text:
True. No time for such thoughts when fighting for one's
friends on the battlefield.

lines.speaker: char_MUMMYMON
lines.text: Maybe it's about time to redo my bandages...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll help you.

lines.speaker: char_MUMMYMON
lines.text:
To render me defenseless, you mean? Sorry for not trusting 
you, but I'll pass.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to see how that works.

lines.speaker: char_MUMMYMON
lines.text:
To observe me, you mean? No, thank you. I'll redo my wraps 
when you aren't looking.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You don't need to fix them.

lines.speaker: char_MUMMYMON
lines.text:
I can't fight well with loose bandages, but if you say so, I'll 
deal with it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: They're a little smelly, honestly.

lines.speaker: char_MUMMYMON
lines.text:
How rude! Although I guess I wouldn't have noticed unless 
you said something...

lines.speaker: char_PENMON
lines.text: Say, is it hot, or is it just me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: char_PENMON
lines.text:
So it's just my heat sensitivity? All right, then. I'll try riding it out 
a little longer.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd say it's cold, if anything.

lines.speaker: char_PENMON
lines.text:
Huh. No one I met at the South Pole liked the cold, either. 
Are all humans that way?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's just right.

lines.speaker: char_PENMON
lines.text:
I knew it. I just can't get comfy without ice around. Let's go 
someplace a little cooler!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's sweltering.

lines.speaker: char_PENMON
lines.text:
You look pretty comfortable to me. Let's go take a dip in 
icy water, you and me!

lines.speaker: char_IKKAKUMON
lines.text: Say, am I really that chubby?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're pretty plump, yeah.

lines.speaker: char_IKKAKUMON
lines.text:
I'm not exactly fast, sure, but plump? It's just a little bulk for my 
Harpoon Torpedo.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Who said you were fat?

lines.speaker: char_IKKAKUMON
lines.text:
I knew it! If anything, I'm slimming down. I've got a lot of stress, 
you know.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're still the same as ever.

lines.speaker: char_IKKAKUMON
lines.text:
Right? Thanks! That's a relief. It's such a weight off my mind.
I'm even feeling peckish.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Couldn't really say, myself.

lines.speaker: char_IKKAKUMON
lines.text:
You're my friend, so keep a close eye on me, okay? Warn me if
I start ballooning up.

lines.speaker: char_YUKIDARUMON
lines.text: I want to invite everyone out to my snow hut!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to live with you.

lines.speaker: char_YUKIDARUMON
lines.text:
You're more than welcome! Just don't catch a cold. It's a bit chilly 
for humans out there.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll go for sure!

lines.speaker: char_YUKIDARUMON
lines.text:
I hope you get to see what I love about living in a world 
of ice and snow.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I think I'll pass.

lines.speaker: char_YUKIDARUMON
lines.text:
Can't stand the cold, huh? I'd better warm up the inside 
of my hut, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't you get cold there?

lines.speaker: char_YUKIDARUMON
lines.text:
I'm fine, of course! Besides, my heart's filled with warmth 
when I'm with you.

lines.speaker: char_MOJYAMON
lines.text:
I hear they call me a "Rare Animal Digimon." What's so rare
about me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: People don't run into you all that often.

lines.speaker: char_MOJYAMON
lines.text:
You can meet me anytime in the hinterland! Though it might be 
too harsh for you humans.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No one knows where you live.

lines.speaker: char_MOJYAMON
lines.text:
Deep in the snowy mountains. But it's sacred ground, so don't 
go trampling around.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nothing I can think of.

lines.speaker: char_MOJYAMON
lines.text: Makes sense. After all, I met all of you, and now we're friends!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're a cool, curious find!

lines.speaker: char_MOJYAMON
lines.text:
You're making me blush under all this fur. Don't worry, though. 
I won't run and hide.

lines.speaker: char_VIKEMON
lines.text: I just can't abide this heat.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't think it's hot.

lines.speaker: char_VIKEMON
lines.text:
Fie! Get too used to this heat, and you'll be frozen solid when
the weather turns cold!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd say it's cold, if anything.

lines.speaker: char_VIKEMON
lines.text:
Ya think so? Ya shouldn't come to the permafrost, then.
Maybe that's for the best.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why not take off some of those clothes?

lines.speaker: char_VIKEMON
lines.text:
Would if I could... But since we're friends now, I'll just try and
get used to this heat.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your fur sure looks nice and toasty.

lines.speaker: char_VIKEMON
lines.text:
More like nice and cold. It's like ice crystals! Want me to cool
ya off?

lines.speaker: char_METALETEMON
lines.text: What word would ya say captures the essence of yours truly?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sneaky...

lines.speaker: char_METALETEMON
lines.text:
E-Excuse me?! Still, you ain't wrong. If anything, that's the 
best compliment ever!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Ultimate.

lines.speaker: char_METALETEMON
lines.text: I'm a Mega, ya know. Get yer facts straight!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Invincible?

lines.speaker: char_METALETEMON
lines.text: Man, you get it! Maybe I oughta jot that across my chest instead?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Strongest!

lines.speaker: char_METALETEMON
lines.text:
You just looking at my chest, or what? Still, you ain't wrong. 
Take a nice, long gander!

lines.speaker: char_LIGHDRAMON
lines.text: I want to take a quick run around here.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can you give me a ride?

lines.speaker: char_LIGHDRAMON
lines.text:
I'm glad such breakneck speeds don't make you queasy, 
but maybe I'd better not.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's run together!

lines.speaker: char_LIGHDRAMON
lines.text:
I like your pluck! Still, I'm real fast, you know. I run at the speed 
of lightning itself.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I think I'll pass, myself.

lines.speaker: char_LIGHDRAMON
lines.text:
But darting across the land feels real good. I wish I could give 
you a ride.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's just take it easy.

lines.speaker: char_LIGHDRAMON
lines.text: If you insist. Let's chill for today. We can save the run for another day.

lines.speaker: char_HOLSMON
lines.text: I'll take a short jaunt through the skies.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Bon voyage!

lines.speaker: char_HOLSMON
lines.text:
I want to survey the ground safety from the air. I'll be back before 
you know it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll watch you from here.

lines.speaker: char_HOLSMON
lines.text:
I'd be impressed if human eyes could follow me. I imagine you'll 
lose track real quick.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Take me with you.

lines.speaker: char_HOLSMON
lines.text:
Flying with you would be pretty fun, but this is no time for games. 
Maybe next time.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: By yourself? That's not fair.

lines.speaker: char_HOLSMON
lines.text:
I wish I could take you with me, but the skies contain their fair 
share of dangers.

lines.speaker: char_PICODEVIMON
lines.text: Hey, boss, what can a 'mon do for ya?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Rub my shoulders.

lines.speaker: char_PICODEVIMON
lines.text:
...Yeah, okay, just don't blame me if I rub the blood right outta 
them, though.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What can you even do?

lines.speaker: char_PICODEVIMON
lines.text:
Anything you want. Honest! And underhanded shenanigans—those 
are my bread and butter!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Go buy me some juice.

lines.speaker: char_PICODEVIMON
lines.text:
C'mon, boss. That's a little... How about a command worthy 
of my crafty cunning?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're doing more than enough already.

lines.speaker: char_PICODEVIMON
lines.text:
Don't be like that. Use me and abuse me all ya want. I'm ready 
and waiting, 24/7!

lines.speaker: char_DEVIMON
lines.text: The power of humans is a trifling thing.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The power of humans is limitless.

lines.speaker: char_DEVIMON
lines.text: Intriguing. I should like to see a display of this power.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The power of Devimon is a trifling thing.

lines.speaker: char_DEVIMON
lines.text:
You have a sharp tongue. However, one day you will need my
strength and intellect.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Human potential is limitless.

lines.speaker: char_DEVIMON
lines.text:
A valid point. Humans do at times act in a manner that defies
logic. Perhaps you, too...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: But we have the power of love.

lines.speaker: char_DEVIMON
lines.text:
Though I will never be deceived by it, love is indeed not a force
to be taken lightly...

lines.speaker: char_VAMDEMON
lines.text: Have you any interest in the dark arts?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not even a little.

lines.speaker: char_VAMDEMON
lines.text:
Hehehe. Drop the act. Any human who would befriend me 
would not say such a thing.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Teach me, teach me!

lines.speaker: char_VAMDEMON
lines.text:
You certainly wear your heart on your sleeve. Pray you do 
enough to earn my favor.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll admit I'm curious.

lines.speaker: char_VAMDEMON
lines.text:
Yes. You befriended me, so you must have some interest. Still, 
I choose who it is I teach.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: They're evil, and have to be stopped.

lines.speaker: char_VAMDEMON
lines.text:
You would try to reform one as wicked as me? Ludicrous! But I look 
forward to the attempt.

lines.speaker: char_LADYDEVIMON
lines.text: I'll say this much. Fights aren't won with empty sentiment!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't use underhanded tricks.

lines.speaker: char_LADYDEVIMON
lines.text:
Would you say that even if you were cornered? I look forward 
to finding out.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What's wrong with a little lip service?

lines.speaker: char_LADYDEVIMON
lines.text: Don't you get it? Lip service won't work on the wicked.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You don't have to worry.

lines.speaker: char_LADYDEVIMON
lines.text:
Hohoho. All right, then. I look forward to the day you come 
to beg for my help.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll leave the sneaky tactics to you.

lines.speaker: char_LADYDEVIMON
lines.text:
Well said! I am craven, cruel and callous. I look forward to 
the day we fight together.

lines.speaker: char_ASTAMON
lines.text: Knife or machine gun? Which should I use today...?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Use both.

lines.speaker: char_ASTAMON
lines.text:
Yeah, good call. I'd like to get in a dark-energy kick while 
I'm at it, too.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The machine gun.

lines.speaker: char_ASTAMON
lines.text:
Oro Salmón's bullets have a will of their own. I should charge 
people to watch me shoot.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The knife.

lines.speaker: char_ASTAMON
lines.text:
I guess a knife would do for playing around with you. Not that 
I'd ever stab ya.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't use either.

lines.speaker: char_ASTAMON
lines.text:
Don't see any targets around, so maybe I'll skip the weapons
for today and just have fun.

lines.speaker: char_SKULLBALUCHIMON
lines.text: DO YOU FEAR DEATH?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I really can't say.

lines.speaker: char_SKULLBALUCHIMON
lines.text: TO FEAR DEATH IS TO BE UNABLE TO FIGHT...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Teach me about it.

lines.speaker: char_SKULLBALUCHIMON
lines.text: I, TOO, WANT TO KNOW...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's terrifying.

lines.speaker: char_SKULLBALUCHIMON
lines.text:
I DO NOT WANT TO FIGHT YOU, BUT ALL WHO FACE ME FACE 
THE THREAT OF DEATH.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not afraid.

lines.speaker: char_SKULLBALUCHIMON
lines.text:
I AM GLAD I DO NOT HAVE TO SEE YOU SHAKEN BY THE THREAT 
OF DEATH.

lines.speaker: char_DEMON
lines.text: Tremble before evil.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Evil will be defeated.

lines.speaker: char_DEMON
lines.text:
Pray that your lack of fear does not rush you into death's
embrace, human.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I fear nothing.

lines.speaker: char_DEMON
lines.text:
Then right this erroneous thinking at once. A lack of due fear
will lead to your demise.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm full of fear.

lines.speaker: char_DEMON
lines.text:
Fear me, an Evil King Digimon with many evil and Dark Angel
Digimon under my command.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I despise evil.

lines.speaker: char_DEMON
lines.text:
The deepest hate springs from the strongest love, it would
seem.

lines.speaker: char_PIEDMON
lines.text: How would you feel about a game of cards?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No cheating, now.

lines.speaker: char_PIEDMON
lines.text:
I hardly need a lecture from you. Someone as strong as me 
doesn't need tricks.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No, thank you.

lines.speaker: char_PIEDMON
lines.text:
Smart move. Avoiding ill-advised competition is the key to a
long life.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That sounds fun.

lines.speaker: char_PIEDMON
lines.text:
Oh? But I'm the one who'll have the fun, you know. You will 
provide the entertainment.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sounds like a yawn.

lines.speaker: char_PIEDMON
lines.text:
Oh, do pardon me. I wouldn't play so boring a game that you'd 
have no chance of winning.

I was meant to be good... A Celestial Cherub Digimon guarding
the Digital World's Kernel.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Anything I can do to help?

If you are prepared to fall into the dark with me, then yes. But 
I cannot go back.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You mean you're not good now?

I am now fanatically evil. Ultimately, I was never anything 
more than a worthless beast.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What are Cherub Digimon?

High-ranking angels. Now that I have fallen into darkness, 
I am simply your friend.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you sure you wanna be here with me?

Even though I have fallen to the corruption of evil, it is my 
choice to be by your side.

lines.speaker: char_ALDAMON
lines.text: I'm often told I resemble someone, but who could it be...?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: BurningGreymon.

lines.speaker: char_ALDAMON
lines.text:
Yes, our talons and tails are similar. Judge for yourself
which of us is stronger, though.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Agunimon.

lines.speaker: char_ALDAMON
lines.text:
Our faces are similar, true, but I'd like you to look
closer and see how we differ.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: AncientGreymon.

lines.speaker: char_ALDAMON
lines.text:
Saying I resemble a quadrupedal dragon is vexing, but at least 
you think I'm strong.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Flamemon.

lines.speaker: char_ALDAMON
lines.text:
Strangely, that does not bother me, though I don't feel I have 
such youthful features.

lines.speaker: char_DORUMON
lines.text: Don't worry. I don't bite.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll never forgive you if you do.

lines.speaker: char_DORUMON
lines.text: But I don't! Honest! Look. Let's just go bash some bad guys together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Liar.

lines.speaker: char_DORUMON
lines.text: I'm not lying! I only bite enemies.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not worried.

lines.speaker: char_DORUMON
lines.text: Good! Because we're friends. Thanks for believing me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You can bite me if you want.

lines.speaker: char_DORUMON
lines.text:
Hey, I never bite my friends. But I suppose I could, if you really 
wanted me to...

lines.speaker: char_GUILMON
lines.text: I wanna dig a hole somewhere.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: char_GUILMON
lines.text:
Okay, then I'm digging a tunnel! I'm gonna try to make it the 
biggest one yet!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No digging.

lines.speaker: char_GUILMON
lines.text:
But I love digging holes... Let me know if there's somewhere
okay to dig!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Dig here! Woof!

lines.speaker: char_GUILMON
lines.text: Woof? I don't make that sound, you know.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Making a new Guilmon lair?

lines.speaker: char_GUILMON
lines.text: Hey, good idea! It can be our secret Guilmon hideout!

lines.speaker: char_ELECMON
lines.text: Aren't my tails cool?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: char_ELECMON
lines.text: ...Wh-What?! You aren't even impressed by how I can fan 'em out?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How many do you have?

lines.speaker: char_ELECMON
lines.text: I've got nine of 'em! Awesome, huh? I can't give ya any, though!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Very cool.

lines.speaker: char_ELECMON
lines.text: Feel free to copy me if ya want!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your tails aren't all that's cool about you.

lines.speaker: char_ELECMON
lines.text: Th-Thanks. I didn't expect such a nice compliment...

lines.speaker: char_TYUMON
