lines.text: Hey, are you happy we're friends now?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: char_TYUMON
lines.text:
What's not to be sure about? I'm not scary. I'll be right here 
with ya forever.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: char_TYUMON
lines.text: But you look super happy. C'mon. Let's get to know each other better!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A little.

lines.speaker: char_TYUMON
lines.text:
...Huh. Do you mean you're a little happy? C'mon. No need to
be shy! You can tell me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I am!

lines.speaker: char_TYUMON
lines.text: Hehe. Then we both like each other. Let's go on a date sometime!

lines.speaker: char_IMPMON
lines.text: Anybody who makes fun of me is in for a world of hurt!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's the wrong attitude to have.

lines.speaker: char_IMPMON
lines.text:
You trying to scold yours truly? Since we're pals, I'll
pretend I didn't hear that...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That goes for me, too.

lines.speaker: char_IMPMON
lines.text:
I got ya. I just gotta show you respect, right? You better
not poke fun at me, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Hey, I hold you in high regard!

lines.speaker: char_IMPMON
lines.text:
Hehe! So you're picking up what I'm putting down, huh? I
guess we'll get along just fine.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's all just get along with each other.

lines.speaker: char_IMPMON
lines.text:
All right. Fine—just to make ya look good. Won't even
prank nobody or nothing.

lines.speaker: char_NUMEMON
lines.text: Say, let's chill somewhere nice and damp.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Not happening.

lines.speaker: char_NUMEMON
lines.text:
Aw, man. And I was so nervous to ask! Here I thought you'd 
make my heart pound even more.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Maybe next time.

lines.speaker: char_NUMEMON
lines.text: You promise? I'll take you to all the best soggy places!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's chill somewhere else.

lines.speaker: char_NUMEMON
lines.text: Then I'll take you somewhere nice and slimy instead. Awesome choice!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just for a little bit.

lines.speaker: char_NUMEMON
lines.text: ...Oh! Now I want to poop a little!

lines.speaker: char_GEOGREYMON
lines.text: I want to come up with a new skill. What do you think it should be?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A brave, head-on, ramming attack!

lines.speaker: char_GEOGREYMON
lines.text:
So just charge in without looking? That'll take some courage... 
but I like it!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A weak point attack that hits where it hurts!

lines.speaker: char_GEOGREYMON
lines.text:
That means finding the enemy's weakness... Another reminder
of why it pays to be smart.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A partner attack where we strike together!

lines.speaker: char_GEOGREYMON
lines.text:
You mean, you attacking with me?! Our friendship would give
me even more power!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Never be reckless! An ironclad guard move!

lines.speaker: char_GEOGREYMON
lines.text:
You're suggesting some defense instead of only attacks? That's 
real nice of you...

lines.speaker: char_GERBEMON
lines.text:
Hey! I know about the mounds of trash humans are pilin' up.
What're ya gonna do about it?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Keep telling everyone to be less wasteful.

lines.speaker: char_GERBEMON
lines.text: Speakin' up takes courage. Good on ya fer leadin' the way!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sort my garbage and recycle properly.

lines.speaker: char_GERBEMON
lines.text:
Good. With the right mindset, trash ain't trash no more, right? 
Ya got my support.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's look for reusable stuff together.

lines.speaker: char_GERBEMON
lines.text:
Good thinkin'. What say we find some matchin' teacups as a
sign of our friendship?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: There's no such thing as trash.

lines.speaker: char_GERBEMON
lines.text:
Hohoho! I like your way of thinkin'. All things deserve to be treated 
with love.

lines.speaker: char_DIGITAMAMON
lines.text:
I dream of opening a restaurant someday that serves huge portions. 
Think it'd succeed?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Definitely. Go for it!

lines.speaker: char_DIGITAMAMON
lines.text:
You think so?! Okay... Now all I need is the guts to see my plan 
through!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Study the location and competition first.

lines.speaker: char_DIGITAMAMON
lines.text: Ah, I get it. You need smarts to run a successful business, huh?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd work there, too!

lines.speaker: char_DIGITAMAMON
lines.text:
That'd be a huge help! The two of us could be the friendliest 
foodsters around!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You can bet I'd eat there every day!

lines.speaker: char_DIGITAMAMON
lines.text:
Hehe. Every day? Shucks... I'd put all the love I could into 
the food, then!

lines.speaker: char_MONZAEMON
lines.text:
People get pretty freaked out the first time they meet me. 
What can I do...?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Be brave and talk to them!

lines.speaker: char_MONZAEMON
lines.text:
Hmm... You're right. It all starts with talking. I'll try to work up 
the courage!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Try analyzing their reaction.

lines.speaker: char_MONZAEMON
lines.text:
So first I have to figure out what's scaring them, huh?
That's a good point. Thanks!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll help you make more friends!

lines.speaker: char_MONZAEMON
lines.text:
I'm glad you're my friend! Let's make a whole bunch more 
buddies together!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I know just how amazing you are.

lines.speaker: char_MONZAEMON
lines.text:
What a lovely thing to say! You might be the only friend I need, 
in the end.

lines.speaker: char_HACKMON
lines.text: Don't treat me like a kid!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: But you are a kid.

lines.speaker: char_HACKMON
lines.text:
...I mean, sure, but I've got more passion in my left pinky than
a whole adult does!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Then act like an adult, already.

lines.speaker: char_HACKMON
lines.text:
And what's not adult about me?! ...Oh. Knee-jerk reactions like 
that, huh?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Cheeky little brat!

lines.speaker: char_HACKMON
lines.text:
How dare you! Just you wait. I'll get so strong, I'll make you eat 
those words!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is that supposed to be cute?

lines.speaker: char_HACKMON
lines.text:
Who said I wanna be cute?! One day, you'll be calling me tough
and cool!

lines.speaker: char_GROWMON
lines.text: My weapons are these cool blades! What are yours?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The courage to take on any opponent.

lines.speaker: char_GROWMON
lines.text: A weapon hidden inside where no one can see is pretty darn cool!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: My Digimon knowledge.

lines.speaker: char_GROWMON
lines.text:
I'm no good at that stuff, but I know it's important. You be the 
brains. I'm the brawn!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: My trustworthy companions.

lines.speaker: char_GROWMON
lines.text: That includes me, right? Because you're definitely someone I trust!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You, my partner.

lines.speaker: char_GROWMON
lines.text:
Hey, now! You trying to make me blush? I appreciate the thought, 
though!

lines.speaker: char_PAILDRAMON
lines.text:
See what happens when you cross the best parts of dragon 
and insect!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Those claws sure look sharp.

lines.speaker: char_PAILDRAMON
lines.text:
I can even launch them. Once I've sunk my spikes into a foe, 
they're not getting away.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You look like you have incredible power.

lines.speaker: char_PAILDRAMON
lines.text:
A dragon's might is strong within me, but don't forget an insect's 
agility backs it up.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What a hard shell you've got.

lines.speaker: char_PAILDRAMON
lines.text:
An insect's carapace offers flawless defense. And I won't forget 
to protect you, too.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What are those things attached to your waist?

lines.speaker: char_PAILDRAMON
lines.text:
They fire energy waves. As long as I draw breath, I'll always fight 
for my friends!

lines.speaker: char_BANCHOLEOMON
lines.text:
Show me what you're made of! If I stood before you as a foe, 
what would you do?!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Answer with my fist.

lines.speaker: char_BANCHOLEOMON
lines.text:
So you have the courage to strike me, do you? I like that
about you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Talk things out and get to know you.

lines.speaker: char_BANCHOLEOMON
lines.text:
So you would choose words, not fists, eh? Not all battles are
won with force, that's true.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Fight until we reached an understanding.

lines.speaker: char_BANCHOLEOMON
lines.text:
Yes, the bond between us will grow strong. To know a friend, 
you must fight them!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't wanna fight you.

lines.speaker: char_BANCHOLEOMON
lines.text:
Heh. You don't wish me to be a foe even in parable. Soft... 
but I like that about you.

lines.speaker: char_GANKOOMON
lines.text:
Anybody who strays from the path of righteousness gets no
mercy.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Bring it on.

lines.speaker: char_GANKOOMON
lines.text:
Well, well. If you've got the guts to throw down with me, going 
astray won't be a worry.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nothing to fear here.

lines.speaker: char_GANKOOMON
lines.text:
Hey, I'll be here to slap some sense into ya, so why not be a 
little naughty?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It might be too late.

lines.speaker: char_GANKOOMON
lines.text:
Don't be stupid. As long as there's light in these eyes of mine, 
it's never too late.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: char_GANKOOMON
lines.text:
Gotta love that innocence. I'll always set ya straight, so do 
whatever ya want!

lines.speaker: char_GRAPLEOMON
lines.text:
For the sake of greater strength, I must go out and train. What
training should I do?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Journey to unseen lands.

lines.speaker: char_GRAPLEOMON
lines.text:
So tempering the heart is more important than the fist? Courage
is paramount in a fight!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Read lots of books.

lines.speaker: char_GRAPLEOMON
lines.text:
I didn't even think of that. The right knowledge lets you dominate 
any foe, huh?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's spar together!

lines.speaker: char_GRAPLEOMON
lines.text:
You'd join me in my training?! I see... Yes, we should grow
stronger together, my partner.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't want you to go train.

lines.speaker: char_GRAPLEOMON
lines.text:
Haha. Worried I wouldn't come back? Well, never fear. If I go,
you're coming with.

lines.speaker: char_BEELSTARMON
lines.text:
A certain someone dares call me "Beelzemon Lady." As if I'd
ever partner with that fool!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Just be better than Beelzemon, then.

lines.speaker: char_BEELSTARMON
lines.text:
True. I hate to admit it, but I AM the lesser-renowned of us. 
I must fight to change that!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Use the nickname to your advantage.

lines.speaker: char_BEELSTARMON
lines.text:
I never thought of that... Using the name could have its benefits. 
You're quite clever.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your partner is standing right here.

lines.speaker: char_BEELSTARMON
lines.text: You know... You're right! Yes... It's you who is my partner!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nicknames don't matter. You are who you are.

lines.speaker: char_BEELSTARMON
lines.text: Hee hee. I had a feeling you'd say that!

lines.speaker: char_SUPERSTARMON
lines.text:
I want to show off my new superstardom in a video!
What would you shoot if you were me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A reverse bungee jump into the stratosphere!

lines.speaker: char_SUPERSTARMON
lines.text:
That'd give everyone an eyeful of my pluck, huh? Got it. I'll 
arrange a jump right away!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Acing a super hard trivia contest?

lines.speaker: char_SUPERSTARMON
lines.text:
Showing off my smarts, huh? Nice! Better swap the shades
for some specs.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A two-person food tour!

lines.speaker: char_SUPERSTARMON
lines.text:
A performance with us at center stage, huh? That'd be a swell 
show of camaraderie!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A 24-hour stream of our life together!

lines.speaker: char_SUPERSTARMON
lines.text:
What? Like, a live video? Hoho! A life with you sounds like a
fun time to me!

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON
lines.text: I'll show you speed invisible to the naked eye!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet you make crazy shockwaves.

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON
lines.text:
My moves do, sure, but the ones fired from my hands and 
chest are way more amazing.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to see it!

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON
lines.text:
Even so, you may only get a glimpse of an afterimage at the 
speed I move at.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: If it's that fast, how can I even see it?

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON
lines.text:
It's not like you can't see it at all. Even just my afterimage is 
something to behold.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How fast are we talking, here?

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON
lines.text:
It's hard to explain, but even if you can't see me, I'm sure you'll 
sense my presence.

lines.speaker: char_CRANIAMON
lines.text:
I'd love you to introduce me to some human food.
What would you recommend?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Spicy hellfire ramen!

lines.speaker: char_CRANIAMON
lines.text:
The name alone tells me I'd need some pluck.
What lies beyond that flavor? I must know!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A DHA-rich fish platter! Plenty of Omega-3!

lines.speaker: char_CRANIAMON
lines.text:
A dish that feeds both the stomach and the brain?
How fantastically efficient!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's have a hotpot party!

lines.speaker: char_CRANIAMON
lines.text:
A meal more enjoyable when eaten together!
It would be an honor to share that with you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll make you a good home-cooked meal.

lines.speaker: char_CRANIAMON
lines.text:
Home cooking? For me? Hoho! I imagine that would be 
tastier than any restaurant's fare.

lines.speaker: char_MEGADRAMON
lines.text:
Humans are supposed to be weak, but I sense a strength of 
sorts. Where does it come from?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Such courage comes from deep within one's heart.

lines.speaker: char_MEGADRAMON
lines.text:
I see. So humans fight despite their frailty. Is that what you call 
"strength of heart"?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: We make up for our weaknesses with wisdom.

lines.speaker: char_MEGADRAMON
lines.text:
Wisdom can compensate for such things? Hmm... Perhaps 
I should expand my own knowledge.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: From joining forces with our friends.

lines.speaker: char_MEGADRAMON
lines.text:
Even small embers can create a fire, yes? Imagine how you and 
I could blaze together.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Our feelings for others make us stronger.

lines.speaker: char_MEGADRAMON
lines.text:
That is difficult to understand. Feelings make you stronger? 
Humans are fascinating.

lines.speaker: char_CYBERDRAMON
lines.text: Have any foes you want deleted?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: "Deleting" sounds a bit harsh.

lines.speaker: char_CYBERDRAMON
lines.text: I erase enemies without a trace. That is my calling.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No need to delete them.

lines.speaker: char_CYBERDRAMON
lines.text: Vaccines annihilate viruses. That is the proper way of things.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: char_CYBERDRAMON
lines.text:
Your foes are my foes. By the time you notice, they will have 
already been erased.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: char_CYBERDRAMON
lines.text:
Impossible. Your foes will be found and erased along with the 
space around them.

lines.speaker: char_METALGREYMON
lines.text: I'm way cooler than that blue jerk, right?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: SO much cooler!

lines.speaker: char_METALGREYMON
lines.text: You and me think alike! I'll fight by your side forever and ever!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're both awesome!

lines.speaker: char_METALGREYMON
lines.text: I wanted you to say me, but you're a pretty swell human, ain't you?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're pretty much the same?

lines.speaker: char_METALGREYMON
lines.text:
You think so? All right, then. I'll have to Digivolve into an 
even cooler form!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I like the blue one better...

lines.speaker: char_METALGREYMON
lines.text:
Why I oughta— Wait. Are you poking fun at me? You should 
just say what you really think!

lines.speaker: char_AEROVEEDRAMON
lines.text:
Hey, you can't fly, right? Well, you can hop on my back. 
Where do you want to fly to?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna go super fast!

lines.speaker: char_AEROVEEDRAMON
lines.text:
Ha! You're a brave kid! My gliding can get pretty intense, 
though! Wanna give it a go?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna go see what's in the clouds.

lines.speaker: char_AEROVEEDRAMON
lines.text:
Hey, I've never seen the clouds up close, either. Seeing how 
they're made might be fun!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's go see a rainbow together.

lines.speaker: char_AEROVEEDRAMON
lines.text:
I heard that rainbows are like bridges that connect friends. 
Maybe we should have a look!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Anywhere is fine as long as we go together.

lines.speaker: char_AEROVEEDRAMON
lines.text:
Hehe... I was thinking the same thing! I'm sure we'll have 
fun wherever we go!

lines.speaker: char_RAPIDMON
lines.text: I am "Rapidmon," not "Rabbitmon." Don't get it twisted!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's all the same to me.

lines.speaker: char_RAPIDMON
lines.text:
As long as I can move and fight quickly, I guess the name isn't 
such a huge deal...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What's the difference?

lines.speaker: char_RAPIDMON
lines.text:
"Rapid" means swift. "Rabbit" doesn't! That's a pretty big 
difference, pal!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you sure it's not "Rabbit"?

lines.speaker: char_RAPIDMON
lines.text:
Your ears clogged or what?! It's "Rapidmon"! We're friends now, 
so you'd better remember!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I know, I know.

lines.speaker: char_RAPIDMON
lines.text:
Whew, that's a relief! Humans get it twisted sometimes, you see. 
Be careful, okay?

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON
lines.text: Which do you like, white or black?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Definitely white.

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON
lines.text:
I slash my foes with my white wing. I'll show you just how 
lethal it is someday.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Must we be so black and white about things?

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON
lines.text:
Very funny... Still, I suppose you're right. Not all things can be 
so clearly divided.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A little of column A, a little of column B.

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON
lines.text:
I, too, am fond of both my white wing and black wing. I'd say 
we have similar tastes.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Black, for sure.

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON
lines.text:
I can conceal myself with my black wing, though I have no need 
to hide from you.

lines.speaker: char_JUSTIMON
lines.text:
What do you think of my red scarf? It suits me quite well, 
wouldn't you agree?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Kind of tangled on you, isn't it?

lines.speaker: char_JUSTIMON
lines.text:
It's just entwined around my neck. I appear and disappear like 
the wind, after all.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A bit long, isn't it?

lines.speaker: char_JUSTIMON
lines.text:
How is it supposed to flutter in the wind, otherwise? This is the 
length of justice.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Suits you to a tee!

lines.speaker: char_JUSTIMON
lines.text:
Thank you kindly. Nothing says "Justimon" quite like a red scarf, 
I must say.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't think it's really you.

lines.speaker: char_JUSTIMON
lines.text:
First I've ever heard such an opinion. Even so, I have faith it'll 
grow on you in time.

lines.speaker: char_RUSTTYRANOMON
lines.text:
I've obtained the ultimate power... but it's not enough. 
Can you tell what's missing?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The courage to retreat.

lines.speaker: char_RUSTTYRANOMON
lines.text:
...I can respect that. Retreat requires the utmost courage, 
yet is sometimes necessary.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Knowledge of the opponent you face.

lines.speaker: char_RUSTTYRANOMON
lines.text:
So knowledge can trump even overwhelming power? Then 
that would make me invincible!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Friends you can trust.

lines.speaker: char_RUSTTYRANOMON
lines.text:
Hmm... Friends push each other to greater heights? Good. 
Become my friend, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Love for those you wanna protect.

lines.speaker: char_RUSTTYRANOMON
lines.text:
Having someone to protect makes you stronger? Then I'll 
protect you on the road ahead.

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSMON
lines.text:
There must be some fun, even for one as short-lived as me. 
Any suggestions?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Adventure to unknown worlds.

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSMON
lines.text:
Just the word "adventure" gets me excited. Adventuring right to 
the end might be nice.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Read tons of books.

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSMON
lines.text:
Yes, I can learn about many times and places, all from here. 
Reading is like a journey.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's play a card game!

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSMON
lines.text:
Heh. A game that can't be played alone, huh? If you play with
me, I'm willing to try.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's just keep on chatting together.

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSMON
lines.text: Hmm... If my time is limited, it might be fun to spend it all with you.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text:
I know I'll never get it, but... what is it about humans that makes 
them so frantic?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Strong feelings make people stronger.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text:
You don't say? Surpassing your original power through emotion alone! 
How odd humans are.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: There's so much we wanna learn.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text:
My, but you humans are greedy. You wish to know what lies beyond 
or is out of sight.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: We wanna be with the friends we care about.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text: Are friends such a valuable thing? In that case, try and befriend me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: We have things we wanna protect.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text:
Is protecting something so important? I don't understand... 
yet nor I do abhor the concept.

lines.speaker: char_GABUMON
lines.text:
I'm gonna have a party with my Digimon friends! What should
we do for fun?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sing a song in front of everyone!

lines.speaker: char_GABUMON
lines.text:
Um... I think I'm too shy for that. But it would be cool. Maybe
I'll be brave and try!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Have a trivia contest.

lines.speaker: char_GABUMON
lines.text:
Wow, that would be lotsa fun! I'm gonna read lotsa books and
make the questions!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Have everyone draw a big picture together.

lines.speaker: char_GABUMON
lines.text:
You mean on the same piece of paper? Sounds like it'd be fun,
and would make for a good memory!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How about making some snacks?

lines.speaker: char_GABUMON
lines.text:
Sounds tricky... but I'd like to show my love for everyone! Hey,
can you help me practice?

lines.speaker: char_AGUMON
lines.text:
I wanna be an adorable mascot character! How can I get 
everyone to like me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Try doing a daring stunt!

lines.speaker: char_AGUMON
lines.text:
Everyone likes watching those, huh? Maybe I'll do a bungie
jump or play chicken!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Show off your intellectual side.

lines.speaker: char_AGUMON
lines.text:
People do love smart quiz masters, huh! Okay, time to hit 
the books and become a brainiac!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll do PR for you.

lines.speaker: char_AGUMON
lines.text:
Huh? You'd spread the word about me? Now, that's a real
friend! I'm counting on you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: People love you the way you are now.

lines.speaker: char_AGUMON
lines.text:
I'm fine the way I am...? You know, maybe you're right. 
Yay, I'm super happy!

lines.speaker: char_V-DRAMON
lines.text:
The mark on my chest looks like a "V," doesn't it? What do you 
think it stands for?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: "Valor." It's a symbol of courage!

lines.speaker: char_V-DRAMON
lines.text:
Whoa, how friggin' cool is that?! I'd better make sure to live up 
to this "V" in combat!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: "Victory." It means you always win!

lines.speaker: char_V-DRAMON
lines.text: "Victory," huh? Hehe. I hope I never let you down!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: "Virtue." You always do the right thing!

lines.speaker: char_V-DRAMON
lines.text:
That's right! And that means I'll never abandon you. You can 
count on me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: "Vitality." You're full of energy and life!

lines.speaker: char_V-DRAMON
lines.text: Vitality? Yeah! I'll always put my vitality to work for you!

lines.speaker: char_XV-MON
lines.text: I still need more power.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You've gotten a lot stronger.

lines.speaker: char_XV-MON
lines.text: Maybe compared to before I Digivolved, but I gotta do better than this!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're pretty cool, though.

lines.speaker: char_XV-MON
lines.text: All that talking me up isn't gonna work! I've grown out of that stuff!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You just have to train more.

lines.speaker: char_XV-MON
lines.text: Right. All I can do is train! I wanna keep Digivolving, so cheer me on!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I like you the way you are.

lines.speaker: char_XV-MON
lines.text:
But I want you to like me even more, and that's why I'm gonna
train to get stronger!

lines.speaker: char_PECKMON
lines.text: Running is WAY faster than flying, I tell you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Those are some sturdy legs you've got.

lines.speaker: char_PECKMON
lines.text:
Yep, you know it. I can run the whole day away, no problem. 
No one can beat me!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's not true.

lines.speaker: char_PECKMON
lines.text:
You'll get it once you see me run. Heck, maybe I'll even give you 
a ride.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Running must feel great.

lines.speaker: char_PECKMON
lines.text:
It sure does. Flying along the ground is the best! Join me. 
You'll see what I mean.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet flying feels even better.

lines.speaker: char_PECKMON
lines.text:
Flying's cool and all, but I'll take a good run any day. Join me 
on the road sometime!

lines.speaker: char_STINGMON
lines.text: Please tell me! What do you fight to protect?!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: My own pride.

lines.speaker: char_STINGMON
lines.text: That must be some pride you have! You have my respect!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Ruins, old tomes and other precious culture.

lines.speaker: char_STINGMON
lines.text:
You'll pass on history to future generations. I, too, will fight 
to protect the ruins!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The friends I believe in.

lines.speaker: char_STINGMON
lines.text:
Yes, friends are more valuable than gold and silver! I'm happy 
to count among yours!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You, my dear partner.

lines.speaker: char_STINGMON
lines.text:
You think of me as your partner?! I'm touched! I'll fight to 
protect you, partner.

lines.speaker: char_WOLFMON
lines.text: A warrior must always walk the path of righteousness.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're allowed to make mistakes sometimes.

lines.speaker: char_WOLFMON
lines.text:
True. Happens to everyone. The most important thing is to
recognize and fix your mistakes.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're always doing the right thing.

lines.speaker: char_WOLFMON
lines.text:
Thanks, but best not to overestimate me. If I blunder, I need
you to tell me right away.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll try to be careful.

lines.speaker: char_WOLFMON
lines.text:
That was not directed at you. Still, nothing better than walking 
the straight and narrow.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're a stand-up Digimon, you know that?

lines.speaker: char_WOLFMON
lines.text:
I am merely saying what a warrior should. Still, I will try to 
live up to those words.

lines.speaker: char_GARURUMON
lines.text:
Am I cool or what? I hear there's different types of coolness,
though, so what kind am I?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The wild kind of cool.

lines.speaker: char_GARURUMON
lines.text:
Hehehe... I knew it! And I'm going to show everyone I don't just
look wild, I AM wild!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The smart kind of cool.

lines.speaker: char_GARURUMON
lines.text:
Well, I'll be. You're really observant. My true charm is in how
much I know!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The reliable kind of cool.

lines.speaker: char_GARURUMON
lines.text:
The cool have a different kind of heart, huh? Don't worry. I'll
never turn on you!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: The lovable kind of cool.

lines.speaker: char_GARURUMON
lines.text:
L-Lovable...? Ugh, come on! Here I am, all embarrassed, but
my tail won't stop wagging!

lines.speaker: char_KYUBIMON
lines.text: I would like to get to know individuals who pray for peace.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd like to be one of them.

lines.speaker: char_KYUBIMON
lines.text:
To wish for peace is the first step toward action. Let us walk 
this path together.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Count me out.

lines.speaker: char_KYUBIMON
lines.text:
Do not make this more complicated than it has to be. 
Surely you, too, desire peace.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Get to know me better, then!

lines.speaker: char_KYUBIMON
lines.text:
I believe you have what it takes to join me in aspiring for 
peace. I believe in you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: A wonderful thing to aspire to.

lines.speaker: char_KYUBIMON
lines.text:
Do not talk as if this has nothing to do with you. I wish to 
know you more than anyone.

lines.speaker: char_GARUMMON
lines.text: I pledge fealty to you, my liege.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Counting on it!

lines.speaker: char_GARUMMON
lines.text:
I wish for us to fight for justice together, so it is I who am
counting on you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: char_GARUMMON
lines.text:
Defend all that is good in the Digital World. I should like to hear 
your thoughts as well.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want us to be equals.

lines.speaker: char_GARUMMON
lines.text:
You are a truly humble human. Even as equals, I would endeavor 
to follow your lead.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I feel a sense of duty now.

lines.speaker: char_GARUMMON
lines.text: And it is that sincerity that drew me to you. Let us smite evil together.

lines.speaker: char_WEREGARURUMON
lines.text: These jeans are pretty sick, aren't they?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: They look good on you, yeah.

lines.speaker: char_WEREGARURUMON
lines.text:
Right? With the good mood they put me in, my kicks and jumps 
are sharper than ever.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That skull's a little creepy.

lines.speaker: char_WEREGARURUMON
lines.text:
It's a message to my foes that I'm coming for their head. 
Psyches 'em out before the fight.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Talk about bad taste.

lines.speaker: char_WEREGARURUMON
lines.text:
Dissing my fashion sense? Given the type of stuff I get up to, 
I'd say it's on point.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I think you've got a rip there?

lines.speaker: char_WEREGARURUMON
lines.text:
They're called "distressed jeans." A human like you should know 
how dope these are.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text: What value is there in us spending time together?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Value has nothing to do with it.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text:
Hehe... My, you do have pluck. I'll allow you to spend a little
more time with me as a treat.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You could learn something.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text:
Hmph. I don't normally notice ants like you.
All the more reason to observe you up close?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: We can become friends.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text:
I don't need friends. Still, you're quite intriguing.
I suppose I could spend some time with you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna save you.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON
lines.text:
Hmph! Such drivel! But still... Perhaps I will observe you a little
longer.

lines.speaker: char_OMEGASHOUTMON
lines.text: If you spot a shiny afterimage, it might be me, you know!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You move at light speed?

lines.speaker: char_OMEGASHOUTMON
lines.text:
That's only the speed of my movement. My intense zeal 
gushes out faster than light!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I've never seen one.

lines.speaker: char_OMEGASHOUTMON
lines.text:
Even an afterimage would be hard to spot. Such is the speed 
afforded by Omni inForce.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to see that!

lines.speaker: char_OMEGASHOUTMON
lines.text:
If you can handle me and my intense zeal, then you'll see it 
for certain!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You might be too fast to see.

lines.speaker: char_OMEGASHOUTMON
lines.text:
If you want to catch sight of me, I can slow down a little.
Just a tick, though.

lines.speaker: char_WARGREYMON
lines.text:
Foes employ craven tactics at times. What should I do if a 
friend is taken hostage?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Cowards deserve a boot to the face!

lines.speaker: char_WARGREYMON
lines.text:
Hahaha! Couldn't have put it better myself! Drive your courage 
down those evildoers' throats!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Fool your foes with deceptive strategies.

lines.speaker: char_WARGREYMON
lines.text:
Oh, that's a pretty cool idea. If all went well, no one would 
even need to get hurt.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Set up a one-two punch with your pals!

lines.speaker: char_WARGREYMON
lines.text:
Good call! No matter how far apart they are, real friends are 
one in mind and heart!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll take the hostage's place.

lines.speaker: char_WARGREYMON
lines.text:
Take their place? Like a hostage exchange? Wow... Such a 
kind answer suits you well.

lines.speaker: char_IMPERIALDRAMON_FM
lines.text:
Sometimes I think I'm so strong, it's scary. Is it all right for me 
to have such power?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want you to have that power.

lines.speaker: char_IMPERIALDRAMON_FM
lines.text:
You trust I won't do anything dumb with it? I'll use it with a valiant 
heart, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Power is all about how you use it.

lines.speaker: char_IMPERIALDRAMON_FM
lines.text:
You mean the right way to wield it? I'll take a page out of my 
ancestors' book, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your friends will always keep you in check.

lines.speaker: char_IMPERIALDRAMON_FM
lines.text:
You're right. I'm not alone. Well, if I ever lose myself... I'll be 
counting on you, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll always be by your side.

lines.speaker: char_IMPERIALDRAMON_FM
lines.text:
All right, then. If you're with me, I know I'll keep using this 
power for good.

lines.speaker: char_GODDRAMON
lines.text: Destruction or rebirth? That is the question.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Destruction.

lines.speaker: char_GODDRAMON
lines.text:
Destroying is easy with my might. I must give due consideration
to what else can be done.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What's this all about?

lines.speaker: char_GODDRAMON
lines.text:
The foes that surround us, and this world. There are many
questions that need resolving.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Rebirth.

lines.speaker: char_GODDRAMON
lines.text:
Rebirth can only follow destruction. If you can bear this truth,
let us move forward.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Both are important.

lines.speaker: char_GODDRAMON
lines.text:
They are the two forces that stabilize this world. Let us sculpt
the future together.

lines.speaker: char_EXAMON
lines.text:
Do not be mistaken. My form is not all that is large about me! 
You understand, yes?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your strong heart is also jumbo size.

lines.speaker: char_EXAMON
lines.text: You know me well. I have a vast heart, fit for this immense body!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your intellect is just as massive.

lines.speaker: char_EXAMON
lines.text:
Precisely. This frame houses not only strength but knowledge of 
all things as well.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Size differences aside, our bond is huge.

lines.speaker: char_EXAMON
lines.text:
Though you are small, I acknowledge your strength. Our bond of 
friendship is firm.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your love is so big, it makes me dizzy.

lines.speaker: char_EXAMON
lines.text:
The size of my love surpasses that of this body. Fear not. I shall 
always keep you safe.

lines.speaker: char_JESMON
lines.text:
I would like a role when I fight together with everyone. What 
part should I play?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Lead the charge!

lines.speaker: char_JESMON
lines.text:
A role suited to my gallantry! I shall cleave a path for my 
compatriots to follow.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Command from behind.

lines.speaker: char_JESMON
lines.text:
A role suited to my perspicacity! My precise instructions shall 
guide our way to victory.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Support our allies.

lines.speaker: char_JESMON
lines.text:
A role suited to my support prowess! I shall ensure that everyone 
can act to their fullest.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll trust you to guard my rear.

lines.speaker: char_JESMON
lines.text:
You would trust me to such an extent?! Of course! Consider your 
back unassailable!

lines.speaker: char_KAISERGREYMON
lines.text: I shall rule over Gaia!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Is that even possible?

lines.speaker: char_KAISERGREYMON
lines.text:
You'll know once I've put my strength on display. I'll show you 
everything I've got!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How would you even do it?

lines.speaker: char_KAISERGREYMON
lines.text:
I have the might of the nine dragon veins. See for yourself what 
that power amounts to!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You can do it!

lines.speaker: char_KAISERGREYMON
lines.text:
But of course! Watch me add the power of eight dragon veins
to my own might!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd like to help.

lines.speaker: char_KAISERGREYMON
lines.text:
I appreciate it, but I have the nine dragon veins on my side. 
That's more than enough!

lines.speaker: char_LEVIAMON
lines.text: You should envy my strength.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Oh, I'm green with envy.

lines.speaker: char_LEVIAMON
lines.text:
Kekeke... Good answer. Wallow in that envy! Until the day 
I devour the Digital World...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you strong enough to warrant envy?

lines.speaker: char_LEVIAMON
lines.text:
Kekeke... Such dreadful ignorance. You'll understand 
everything the day I consume you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: There's no point. You're just too strong.

lines.speaker: char_LEVIAMON
lines.text:
Kekeke... That works for me. Let's see if you end up fawning 
over me or worshipping me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Far from it. I think it's great!

lines.speaker: char_LEVIAMON
lines.text:
Kekeke... If you can't beat them, join them, right? I'll pull 
you into the fold, then.

lines.speaker: char_SLEIPMON
lines.text: Which would you rather deal with, scorching heat, or bitter cold?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Scorching heat!

lines.speaker: char_SLEIPMON
lines.text:
To choose the lick of flame over piercing chill—that is some 
respectable resolve.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Bitter cold...

lines.speaker: char_SLEIPMON
lines.text:
One can hardly resist flame, but a certain determination is needed 
to endure the cold.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's all the same to me.

lines.speaker: char_SLEIPMON
lines.text:
Resigned to either fate, are you? There is something noble 
about that. Not bad.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can I say neither?

lines.speaker: char_SLEIPMON
lines.text:
I would call that a natural human reaction. Worry not. I shall
protect you from both.

lines.speaker: char_METALGARURUMON
lines.text:
Tell me the first word that pops into your head when you hear 
the word "metal."

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Hard!

lines.speaker: char_METALGARURUMON
lines.text:
I'm quite proud of my smooth moves, despite all this hard
armor. Watch! I'll get your blood pumping.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Machine!

lines.speaker: char_METALGARURUMON
lines.text:
True. I'm basically a walking, talking, weapon-toting machine.
We should count up all my weapons sometime.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Cold!

lines.speaker: char_METALGARURUMON
lines.text:
I may breathe out absolute-zero blasts, but my body and soul 
are always burning hot.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sturdy?

lines.speaker: char_METALGARURUMON
lines.text:
Sure, though I protected my friends with my sturdy body even 
before I got this metal.

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON_BM
lines.text: I'm dangerous in this form. You shouldn't get too close...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I can tell just by looking at you.

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON_BM
lines.text:
Then I suggest you step back. My planet-class energy is nothing 
to make light of.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What's so dangerous about you?

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON_BM
lines.text:
My abilities have been fully released. This planet-class energy 
could destroy everything.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wasn't planning on it, anyway.

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON_BM
lines.text:
I'm glad. Once I've done what I have to do and canceled 
Burst Mode, let's meet again.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Even so, I still wanna be by your side.

lines.speaker: char_MIRAGEGAOGAMON_BM
lines.text:
Please don't upset me. I don't want my planet-class energy 
to cause you any harm...

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAGARURUMON
lines.text: I'll show you what the speed of light truly looks like.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to see that!

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAGARURUMON
lines.text:
I'd be surprised if you could even see my afterimage. I shoot up 
to high altitude fast.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You move at light speed?

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAGARURUMON
lines.text:
Actually, I fly at subluminal speed. Not much different, in the 
grand scheme of things.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet watching would make me queasy.

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAGARURUMON
lines.text:
Staring at flickering light is bad for human eyes. No need to 
push yourself like that.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I bet it's really bright.

lines.speaker: char_MAGNAGARURUMON
lines.text:
When battle begins, a dazzling flash darts across the sky. 
That lets you know I'm here.
I don't need any armor to fight!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You look light on your feet.

That's right. I'm way faster than I was with the armor 
attached—faster than light, even!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What about your weapons?

The armor was fine but speed's always been my greatest 
weapon—especially my bands of light.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I believe you.

Thank you. I can do anything with the faith of my friends. 
Watch my superluminal speed!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Isn't that dangerous?

Shedding my armor doesn't mean I'm unarmed. I'm so fast 
you won't have time to worry!

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON_BM
lines.text: ...Can't you feel it? The vast energy crackling through the air?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wish I could.

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON_BM
lines.text:
Behold my dark purple aura. Perhaps then will you come to sense 
this abundant energy.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can't feel it at all.

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON_BM
lines.text:
Is it futile for humans? You should be able to see it, though. 
It's my dark purple aura.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Oh, I feel it.

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON_BM
lines.text:
That shouldn't be possible for humans, but if you say so, I'll 
believe you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll pass on feeling it.

lines.speaker: char_RAVEMON_BM
lines.text:
Are you afraid of being overwhelmed by this energy? Don't 
worry. I can control it.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON
lines.text: Are there any evildoers afoot?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: There might be.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON
lines.text:
Then you and I, Gallantmon, must root them out and mete justice
upon their wicked souls!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON
lines.text:
Then a thorough investigation is in order. None may escape
Gallantmon's keen gaze.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: There are.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON
lines.text:
Then I, Gallantmon, shall deliver punishment forthwith. And
you shall be at my side!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON
lines.text:
I am glad. I, Gallantmon, will brook not even the tiniest of misdeeds! 
Peace must be kept!

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON_CM
lines.text:
Now that I possess wings and crimson armor, I, Gallantmon,
am invincible!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You do look pretty strong.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON_CM
lines.text:
With my full power unleashed, I, Gallantmon, am most assuredly
mighty.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You must be hot in all that.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON_CM
lines.text:
My crimson armor is evidence of the burning power surging
within me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I like the old Gallantmon better.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON_CM
lines.text:
Such might cannot persist forever. Like it or no, I will revert to
my former self in time.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I hope you stay like this forever.

lines.speaker: char_DUKEMON_CM
lines.text:
Sadly, as my power wanes, I will revert to my old form. I must
shine bright while I can!

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSDUKEMON
lines.text: Once you fall, the dark and gloom are not so bad.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm disappointed in you.

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSDUKEMON
lines.text:
Say what you will, but I, ChaosGallantmon, shall bring disaster 
upon the Digital World!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Do you do bad things?

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSDUKEMON
lines.text:
Of course. The instincts of ChaosGallantmon compel me to
bring about calamity and ruin.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't do anything bad.

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSDUKEMON
lines.text:
Friend or no, ChaosGallantmon cannot comply. My instincts
compel me to summon calamity.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That doesn't suit you.

lines.speaker: char_CHAOSDUKEMON
lines.text:
It may not now, but soon the darkness will claim I, ChaosGallantmon. 
You shall see.

lines.speaker: char_MEDIEVALDUKEMON
lines.text: Do you know of the Digital World in another dimension?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What kind of world is it?

lines.speaker: char_MEDIEVALDUKEMON
lines.text:
An immature world on the road to ruin, unable to protect itself 
from outside invaders.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't get what you mean.

lines.speaker: char_MEDIEVALDUKEMON
lines.text:
The Digital World you know is not the only one out there. 
There are others, you know.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I know about it.

lines.speaker: char_MEDIEVALDUKEMON
lines.text:
Then you must know of me as well: MedievalGallantmon, 
the Whirlwind General.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Never heard of it.

lines.speaker: char_MEDIEVALDUKEMON
lines.text:
It is called "Witchelny." It is my beloved world, although its 
magic is still somewhat unrefined.

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON
lines.text: I am loath to stand revealed before a human as I am now...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna see more of you.

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON
lines.text:
I suppose there is no harm. But know that you are the first
human to view me this closely.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna see you fight.

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON
lines.text:
My battles are not for amusement, and your eyes would 
perceive but a moment regardless.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Okay. I won't stare.

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON
lines.text:
Most considerate, for a human. If only all holy warriors 
were like you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll pretend I never saw you.

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON
lines.text:
The past can only rarely be undone, but as it is you who saw
me, I am not overly troubled.

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON_OURYUKEN
lines.text:
Now that I am a sword, the entirety of my combat ability is 
devoted solely to offense!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How did you end up like that?

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON_OURYUKEN
lines.text:
A miraculous Digivolution only possible through Alphamon's 
magic circle of DigiCode.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Are you Alphamon?

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON_OURYUKEN
lines.text:
I am not Alphamon, but formerly Ouryumon. Through
Digivolution, I am now Alphamon's blade.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Can I wield you?

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON_OURYUKEN
lines.text:
Only Alphamon may wield me. It is impossible for any other 
Digimon, much less a human.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Sorry you got turned into a sword.

lines.speaker: char_ALPHAMON_OURYUKEN
lines.text:
It is nothing to be sorry about. This form is the greatest honor 
for a Prototype Digimon.

lines.speaker: char_LOADKNIGHTMON
lines.text:
I have my own system of justice. And I refuse to engage in 
debate about it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That doesn't seem right.

lines.speaker: char_LOADKNIGHTMON
lines.text:
What did I just say? Still, I suppose you're free to have 
whatever opinion you like.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Your way of thinking is wrong.

lines.speaker: char_LOADKNIGHTMON
lines.text:
What did I just say? Say whatever you want. Your opinions 
are all just nonsense to me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're right to think that way.

lines.speaker: char_LOADKNIGHTMON
lines.text:
I don't remember asking your opinion. Still, at least you're 
not trying to argue.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I guess that's one way to think of things.

lines.speaker: char_LOADKNIGHTMON
lines.text:
And what other way is there? I don't condone insolence, but 
I admit I care what you think.

lines.speaker: char_DYNASMON
lines.text: I will gladly lay down my life for my liege.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Even if your liege is evil?

lines.speaker: char_DYNASMON
lines.text:
Good or evil is for my liege to decide. I merely serve my liege 
to the end.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: That's crazy talk.

lines.speaker: char_DYNASMON
lines.text:
I am not telling you to lay down your life. You need but act on 
your own beliefs.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Good for you.

lines.speaker: char_DYNASMON
lines.text:
Many humans do not understand, but it seems you do. I see us 
having a lasting friendship.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You should value your life more.

lines.speaker: char_DYNASMON
lines.text:
While your concern for my well-being gladdens me, my liege 
comes before all.

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON
lines.text: Strategy is everything when it comes to controlling a battle.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: My strategies are better.

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON
lines.text: Superior to mine? Interesting... Let us see what you can do, then.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It takes more than strategy to win.

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON
lines.text:
The excuse of one who lacks strategic vision. I shall prove how
wrong you are soon enough.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Oh, yeah? Tell me about your strategies...

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON
lines.text:
Well, for instance—Wait! I nearly revealed my hand. I shall have
to be more guarded...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Whatever your strategy is, count me in.

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON
lines.text:
Agreeing without knowing the details is foolish, but you are right
to trust me.

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON_LM
lines.text:
My combat abilities, too, are without flaw. You may entrust
everything to me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No, thanks.

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON_LM
lines.text:
Such bravado gains you nothing. You should at least observe
my excellence in combat first.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: All right. Then, prove it.

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON_LM
lines.text:
I dislike being spoken down to, but you will change your tone
once you see me in action.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll be counting on you.

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON_LM
lines.text:
A wise decision. You will not be sorry. Be thankful that you have 
good allies.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You're really sure of yourself, huh?

lines.speaker: char_DUFTMON_LM
lines.text:
I have both a strategic mind and the combat prowess to back
it up. You must respect that.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYDRAMON
lines.text:
Illuminating all of the darkness with holy light! That is my
mission!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yes, please do.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYDRAMON
lines.text:
This is all for the Digital World. I shall not allow any evil to lurk
in the shadows!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Man, that's bright.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYDRAMON
lines.text:
On the contrary, my light is still lacking. Please tell me
wherever darkness may hide.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's shine that light together.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYDRAMON
lines.text:
Please leave this to me. You lack technique suitable for the
task.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: You can't illuminate all the darkness.

lines.speaker: char_HOLYDRAMON
lines.text:
I shall. I must! I cannot allow my friends to be swallowed by 
the shadows!

lines.speaker: char_ULFORCEVDRAMON
lines.text: None can surpass my divine swiftness.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I can do it with super divine swiftness.

lines.speaker: char_ULFORCEVDRAMON
lines.text:
There is no such thing. Word games and wild delusions will 
not work with me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want divine swiftness so I can keep up.

lines.speaker: char_ULFORCEVDRAMON
lines.text:
Dreams, hopes and goals are good, but we shall see if the
human mind can match my speed.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Nothing could ever be faster.

lines.speaker: char_ULFORCEVDRAMON
lines.text:
Ah, so you understand. Strive to improve, but also know 
your limitations.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not trying to compete with you.

lines.speaker: char_ULFORCEVDRAMON
lines.text:
Giving up without a fight? Yet it was not my intent to make
you yield. Let us be friends.

lines.speaker: char_BARBAMON
lines.text: Desire stirs all to action. Human, unleash your greed!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No one's greedier than me.

lines.speaker: char_BARBAMON
lines.text:
You suggest your greed could surpass that of an Evil King? 
Then let desire rule the day!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I rein in my desires.

lines.speaker: char_BARBAMON
lines.text:
There is no need for self-restraint. Come, now. Show me your 
unabashed greed!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Greed isn't healthy.

lines.speaker: char_BARBAMON
lines.text:
Is that sarcasm? It will be amusing to see which of us
succumbs to greed first.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I don't desire anything.

lines.speaker: char_BARBAMON
lines.text:
Impossible. One day I shall bring forth the greed buried deep 
within your heart!

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEBUMON
lines.text: Just leave me alone. I don't work well with others.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Aw, don't go. I'll miss you.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEBUMON
lines.text:
I didn't say I was leaving. I'll be right here, so no need to be
sad.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: But I wanna talk to you sometimes.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEBUMON
lines.text: Fine, as long as you tell me something I don't already know.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna be friends.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEBUMON
lines.text:
I'm not saying I don't like you. I just don't want to team up 
with anyone.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna know all about you.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEBUMON
lines.text:
You're a weird human... But we don't need to team up for you 
to learn about me.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEMON_BM
lines.text: Don't be so scared. I hardly ever get angry.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna see what you look like angry.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEMON_BM
lines.text: The only time anyone sees me angry is right before they die.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Okay, then smile.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEMON_BM
lines.text: I do if I have a reason to. So come on. Try and make me laugh.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I wanna try to make you mad.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEMON_BM
lines.text: Not possible, mainly because I like you.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: But you look cool when you're angry.

lines.speaker: char_BEELZEMON_BM
lines.text:
You got the wrong idea. No one who sees me angry lives to
talk about it.

lines.speaker: char_LILITHMON
lines.text: Are you willing to fall from grace with me?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd like to give it a shot.

lines.speaker: char_LILITHMON
lines.text:
You understand what it means to fall with me, don't you? 
Be sure you're prepared.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Oh, I'm already there.

lines.speaker: char_LILITHMON
lines.text:
...I'm not sure what that means, but perhaps you should 
re-examine yourself a bit more?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let's aspire to greater things, together.

lines.speaker: char_LILITHMON
lines.text:
If you mean to reach greater heights through nefarious 
means, then I'm here for it.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Don't misjudge me, now.

lines.speaker: char_LILITHMON
lines.text: Hohoho! I love it when humans put up a brave front like that.

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_RM
lines.text:
Are you the one who woke me from my thousand-year
slumber?!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_RM
lines.text:
Who woke me doesn't matter right now, but be prepared,
because I always get my revenge.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: If it upsets you, why not go back to sleep?

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_RM
lines.text:
I never thought of that... Whether it works or not, it's worth a
try.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: What if I am?

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_RM
lines.text:
Normally I'd destroy you, but I'm still too drowsy. So you're
off the hook for now.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_RM
lines.text:
It doesn't feel like it's been a thousand years yet. I'd like to sleep 
a little longer.

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_SM
lines.text: Zzz... *snore*

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Wow, talk about loud snoring!

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_SM
lines.text: Hey...! Be quiet or you'll be in for it... Zzz...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Probably a grumpy riser, so I'll leave it be.

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_SM
lines.text: Wha—?! ...Oh. Guess it's not time to wake up yet... Zzz...

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: It's sleeping so peacefully. I'll be quiet.

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_SM
lines.text: Zzz... Zzz... *mumble*

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'll plug its nose to stop the snoring.

lines.speaker: char_BELPHEMON_SM
lines.text: *snort* Huh? *snort* Huh?! Zzz...

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON_SM
lines.text: Would you like to seal me away?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Yes, I would.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON_SM
lines.text:
You certainly are candid... Still, that is impossible. I am merely 
a shadow of Lucemon.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I honestly don't know.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON_SM
lines.text: Go and revisit the ancient texts. It is up to you to believe them or not.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I want you to be my friend.

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON_SM
lines.text:
You would entice me, who bears the Crowns of the Deadly Sins? 
Let us see where this goes.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: How could I possibly?

lines.speaker: char_LUCEMON_SM
lines.text:
Of course, it is beyond your capabilities. Still, our current 
coexistence is fine by me.

lines.speaker: char_FLAMEDRAMON
lines.text: My courage is a blazing inferno!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Let it blaze even hotter.

lines.speaker: char_FLAMEDRAMON
lines.text:
Say no more. My courage is gonna blaze right there alongside
my flames!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Why so much courage?

lines.speaker: char_FLAMEDRAMON
lines.text:
Because I've got the Digi-Egg of Courage. But I'd be full of courage 
even without it!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I think it's blazing a little too hot.

lines.speaker: char_FLAMEDRAMON
lines.text:
Oops. Really? Sometimes I don't catch that on my own, so thanks 
for telling me.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I feel brave now, too.

lines.speaker: char_FLAMEDRAMON
lines.text: So I set your courage ablaze, too? Guess we're the ultimate team!

lines.speaker: char_ENBARRMON
lines.text: Do you want to climb aboard me and travel the world?

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: Maybe just a little.

lines.speaker: char_ENBARRMON
lines.text:
Curious but timid, eh? No need to commit right now. 
Just get ready for a long journey!

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: No, thanks.

lines.speaker: char_ENBARRMON
lines.text:
I had not thought you so cautious. They do say it is better to 
act than worry, you know.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'm not looking to die.

lines.speaker: char_ENBARRMON
lines.text:
Human or no, I would not let a friend die. You will not perish 
while astride my back.

lines.speaker: char_PLAYER_M
lines.text: I'd love to!

lines.speaker: char_ENBARRMON
lines.text:
Understood. Though I cannot take you now, I vow to fulfill 
my promise before you die.
